timeline.text_zh:
Anthropic 宣布推出 OSS Scanner，这是一项可选加入（opt-in）的服务，使用其模型对开源软件代码库进行全面的定期安全扫描，并免费向相关项目提示潜在漏洞。

据来源称，选择加入的开源项目可能更早收到潜在安全问题的提示；其代价则与 OSS Scanner 的运作方式有关。

该服务对参与的开源项目免费，并使用 Anthropic 最强的模型进行定期扫描；参与方式为自愿加入而非自动纳入，公司还为该服务维护了一个公开代码库。
timeline.text_en:
Anthropic announced OSS Scanner, an opt-in service that uses its models to run thorough, periodic security scans of open-source software repositories and alert projects to potential vulnerabilities at no cost.

According to the source, open-source projects that opt in could be alerted about possible security issues sooner; the trade-off is described as stemming from how OSS Scanner works.

The service is described as free to participating open-source projects and uses Anthropic's strongest models for periodic scanning; participation is opt-in rather than automatic, and the company maintains a public repository for the service.

timeline.text_zh: Anthropic 将其 Cyber Verification Program 扩展为三个层级——Defense、Red Team 和 Specialized——为经过审核的安全组织在 Claude Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5 和 Mythos 5.1 上放宽网络安全防护限制，其中 Red Team 层级允许经授权的渗透测试，据报道在标准模型上被完全拦截的 50 项复杂攻击任务中完成了 34 项。
timeline.text_en: Anthropic expanded its Cyber Verification Program into three tiers — Defense, Red Team, and Specialized — granting vetted security organizations reduced cybersecurity guardrails on Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Mythos 5.1, with the Red Team tier allowing authorized penetration testing and reportedly completing 34 of 50 complex attack tasks that were fully blocked on the standard model.

threads.title_zh: Bitmine 持续买入以太坊并计划在持仓达到 5% 后停止
threads.title_en: Bitmine keeps buying Ethereum and plans to stop once holdings reach 5%
threads.summary_zh: BitMine 持有约 602 万枚 ETH（占流通供应量约 4.9%），并已设定 5% 的硬上限，达到后将停止增持；预计还需 6–7 周触及上限。此前披露的 507 万枚 ETH 质押状态未在本次更新中提及。
threads.summary_en: BitMine holds approximately 6.02 million ETH (~4.9% of circulating supply) and has set a 5% hard cap, after which it will stop accumulating; it expects to reach the cap in 6–7 weeks. The previously disclosed staking of 5.07 million ETH was not addressed in this update.
threads.latest_update_zh: Tom Lee 在新加坡 Token2049 表示，BitMine 已将持有 ETH 流通供应量的 5% 设为硬上限，达到后停止买入；当前持有约 6,016,414 枚 ETH（占比约 4.9%），还需约 9 万至 10 万枚 ETH 触及上限，预计需 6–7 周。停止增持后无需再为买币融资。
threads.latest_update_en: At Token2049 Singapore, Tom Lee said BitMine has set a hard cap of 5% of ETH circulating supply and will stop buying once reached; it currently holds ~6,016,414 ETH (~4.9% of supply), needs ~90k–100k more ETH to hit the cap, expected in 6–7 weeks. After stopping, no further financing for purchases is needed.
threads.background_zh: 以太坊的权益证明系统将共识影响力赋予验证者，其签名密钥授权区块提议与证明，因此拥有为验证者提供资金的 ETH 本身并不能揭示谁能够履行这些职责。质押安排通常分离三种角色：ETH 所有者、节点运营商以及签名密钥的托管方，而以太坊将签名密钥与提款凭证分离的设计，旨在降低委托质押时的信任假设。分布式验证者技术更进一步，将单个验证者的签名密钥拆分到多台机器和多个运营商上，从而消除单点故障。
threads.background_en: Ethereum's proof-of-stake system assigns consensus influence to validators, whose signing keys authorize block proposals and attestations, so owning the ETH that funds a validator does not by itself reveal who can perform those duties. Staking arrangements commonly separate three roles — the ETH owner, the node operator, and whoever custodies the signing keys — and Ethereum's design of separating signing keys from withdrawal credentials is meant to reduce trust assumptions when staking is delegated. Distributed validator technology goes further by splitting a single validator's signing key across multiple machines and operators, removing single points of failure.

threads.latest_summary_en: At Token2049 Singapore, Tom Lee said BitMine has set a hard cap of 5% of ETH circulating supply, holding ~6.02M ETH (4.9%) and needing roughly 90k-100k more (~6-7 weeks) before it stops buying.
threads.market_impact_zh: 其传导路径在于市场结构而非价格：它影响与 ETH 质押相关的资金流、机构托管与质押服务配置决策，以及市场参与者对以太坊最终确定性与抗审查风险的评估。若更多第三方 ETH 通过 MAVAN 迁移到与 BitMine 相关的基础设施上，将扩大运营商构成与密钥托管仍不透明的资金池，因此验证者群组与签名密钥的披露是这一事件传导至市场的主要渠道。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through market structure rather than price: it matters for ETH staking-related flows, for institutional custody and staking-service allocation decisions, and for how participants assess Ethereum's finality and censorship-resistance risk. Any further migration of third-party ETH onto BitMine-linked infrastructure through MAVAN would widen the pool whose operator mix and key custody remain opaque, making validator-cohort and signing-key disclosures the main channel through which this story reaches markets.

threads.title_zh: 英国制裁Cryptomus、Heleket与TokenSpot，指其涉嫌协助俄罗斯规避制裁
threads.title_en: 英国制裁Cryptomus、Heleket与TokenSpot，指其涉嫌协助俄罗斯规避制裁
threads.summary_zh: 英国对Cryptomus、Heleket、TokenSpot及相关支付平台和莫斯科银行实施对俄制裁，并新增Xeltox Enterprises、Tsunami Payments、Processing KG及其董事等指定对象，同时施加互联网服务制裁，指其协助俄罗斯规避制裁。
threads.summary_en: The UK has sanctioned Cryptomus, Heleket, TokenSpot, related payment platforms and a Moscow bank over Russia sanctions evasion, adding designations including Xeltox Enterprises, Tsunami Payments, Processing KG and its director, along with internet services sanctions, citing facilitation of Russian sanctions circumvention.

threads.latest_update_en: The report adds further specific designations from the same UK Russia sanctions round: Xeltox Enterprises (Canadian owner of Cryptomus), Kyrgyz payment firms TokenSpot and Tsunami Payments, Processing KG (VexPay operator) and its director Ulan Bukabaev; it also notes internet services sanctions and identifies the A7 network as a Kremlin-backed illicit finance network.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The UK sanctioned three crypto exchanges — including Xeltox Enterprises, which it says owns Cryptomus — plus Kyrgyz payment firms TokenSpot and Tsunami Payments, as part of a 38-designation package aimed at Russian sanctions circumvention.
threads.latest_summary_en: The UK sanctioned three crypto exchanges — including Xeltox Enterprises, which it says owns Cryptomus — plus Kyrgyz payment firms TokenSpot and Tsunami Payments, as part of a 38-designation package aimed at Russian sanctions circumvention.

threads.title_zh: THORChain 高管指责 Tether 暂时冻结 USDT 金库
threads.title_en: Tether Blacklists Four THORChain Vaults Holding 1.45 Million USDT
threads.summary_zh: Tether 短暂黑名单并冻结 THORChain 四个 USDT 金库地址约 145 万 USDT，导致交易暂停；数小时后地址被解冻，交易恢复，双方未解释原因。
threads.summary_en: Tether briefly blacklisted and froze four THORChain USDT vault addresses holding about 1.45 million USDT, pausing trading; the addresses were unfrozen hours later, trading resumed, and neither side explained the action.
threads.latest_update_zh: Tether 在数小时后解冻了此前被列入黑名单的四个 THORChain USDT 金库地址，约 145 万 USDT 被冻结后恢复，THORChain 交易随之恢复。
threads.latest_update_en: Tether unfroze the four previously blacklisted THORChain USDT vault addresses hours later, restoring access to about 1.45 million USDT and allowing THORChain trading to resume.
threads.background_zh: 据 Valken 介绍，Tether 的黑名单在智能合约层面通过只有 Tether 可调用的 addBlackList 函数执行，该发行方已冻结逾 44 亿美元、涉及 1200 多个地址的 USDT。THORChain 通过原生金库而非桥接合约结算 Tron 资产。本周早些时候，跨境支付平台 Conduit Technology 起诉 Tether，指其冻结了一个与巴西当局 2024 年调查相关钱包中价值 276 万美元的 USDT；两名泰国公民也在 8 月起诉 Tether，称其在美国国土安全调查局（HSI）的「非正式请求」下冻结了 4240 万美元的 USDT。
threads.background_en: Tether's blacklist is enforced at the smart contract level through an addBlackList function that only Tether can call, and the issuer has frozen over $4.4 billion in USDT across more than 1,200 addresses, according to Valken. THORChain settles Tron assets through native vaults rather than bridge contracts. Earlier this week, cross-border payments platform Conduit Technology sued Tether, alleging it froze $2.76 million in USDT in a wallet tied to a 2024 investigation by Brazilian authorities, and two Thai nationals sued in August over an alleged freeze of $42.4 million following an "informal request" from US Homeland Security Investigations.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Tether briefly blacklisted THORChain's USDt vault addresses — freezing about 1.45 million USDT across four wallets and pausing trading — before unfreezing them hours later with no explanation from either side.
threads.latest_summary_en: Tether briefly blacklisted THORChain's USDt vault addresses — freezing about 1.45 million USDT across four wallets and pausing trading — before unfreezing them hours later with no explanation from either side.
threads.market_impact_zh: THORChain 的 Tron 金库持有原生 USDT-TRC20，不经桥接合约结算，因此发行方层面的冻结会在解除前直接阻断该板块的兑换、充值与签名，表明 Tether 发行的流动性带有发行方可控的「开关」。该事件使依赖 Tron 上 USDT 的 DeFi 协议与交易场所继续承受审查风险，也波及通过 RUNE 暴露于 THORChain 跨链流动性的市场参与者。
threads.market_impact_en: THORChain's Tron vaults hold native USDT-TRC20 settled without bridge contracts, so an issuer-level freeze directly blocks swaps, deposits and signing for that segment until it is reversed, showing that Tether-issued liquidity carries an issuer-controlled kill switch. The episode leaves a censorship-risk overhang on DeFi protocols and venues that depend on USDT on Tron, and on RUNE exposure to THORChain's cross-chain liquidity.

threads.title_zh: 韩国多家金融机构疑遭AI攻击，黑客在Claude Code留下身份线索
threads.title_en: 韩国多家金融机构疑遭AI攻击，黑客在Claude Code留下身份线索
threads.summary_zh: 韩国监管机构和 CrowdStrike 已将七家以上金融机构的数据泄露事件与一名攻击者联系起来，该攻击者使用开源代理式渗透测试框架 ARTEX，并借助 DeepSeek v4.1-flash、Claude Code、GLM-5.3 和 Grok 4.6 驱动，影响数万名客户；一名疑似 Telegram 账户否认参与。ARTEX 开发者已宣布闭源并下架 GitHub 原始仓库，但源码已被他人备份。
threads.summary_en: South Korean regulators and CrowdStrike have linked data breaches at seven-plus financial institutions, affecting tens of thousands of customers, to an attacker using the open-source agentic pentest framework ARTEX driven by DeepSeek v4.1-flash along with Claude Code, GLM-5.3 and Grok 4.6, with a suspect Telegram account denying involvement. The ARTEX developer has now closed the project and removed the original GitHub repository, though the source code has been backed up by others.

threads.latest_update_en: ARTEX developer Autumn-27 announced on October 8 that the project is going closed-source, stopping updates and no longer releasing new versions or providing maintenance support; the original GitHub repository was subsequently removed. The source code has been backed up by other developers.

threads.title_zh: Webull 因被指与中国存在“结构性”关联的报道而暴跌 32%
threads.title_en: Webull plunged 32% on report of ‘structural’ ties to China
threads.summary_zh: 美国众议院美中战略竞争特别委员会发布 23 页报告，称 Webull 存在与中国关联的数据安全风险，Webull 股价当日收跌 19% 至 5.89 美元；Webull 回应称报告存在重大不实，美国客户数据存储于美国境内，敏感数据访问权限由美国方面控制。
threads.summary_en: The US House Select Committee on the CCP released a 23-page report alleging China-linked data security risks at Webull, sending its shares down 19% to close at $5.89; Webull denied the report as materially false, saying US client data is stored domestically and sensitive access is controlled by US parties.
threads.latest_update_zh: Webull 发言人称该报告包含重大不实之处和缺乏依据的结论，并称美国客户数据存储于美国境内，敏感数据访问权限由美国方面控制；报告发布当日 Webull 股价收跌 19%，报 5.89 美元。
threads.latest_update_en: A Webull spokesperson called the report materially false and said US client data is stored domestically under US-controlled access; the stock closed down 19% at $5.89 on the day the report was released.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The US House Select Committee on the CCP released a 23-page report alleging China-linked data security risks at crypto-trading broker Webull, sending its shares down 19%, while Webull called the report materially false and said US client data is stored domestically under US-controlled access.
threads.latest_summary_en: The US House Select Committee on the CCP released a 23-page report alleging China-linked data security risks at crypto-trading broker Webull, sending its shares down 19%, while Webull called the report materially false and said US client data is stored domestically under US-controlled access.

timeline.text_zh: Webull 发言人称该报告包含重大不实之处和缺乏依据的结论，并称美国客户数据存储于美国境内，敏感数据访问权限由美国方面控制；报告发布当日 Webull 股价收跌 19%，报 5.89 美元。
timeline.text_en: A Webull spokesperson called the report materially false and said US client data is stored domestically under US-controlled access; the stock closed down 19% at $5.89 on the day the report was released.

timeline.text_zh: 美国一个两党国会委员会报告将拥有2800万用户的券商Webull列为国家安全风险，指其所有权、人员、技术和合规在结构上与中国挂钩，Webull股价一度暴跌32%。
timeline.text_en: Webull shares plunged as much as 32% after a bipartisan US congressional committee report labeled the 28-million-user brokerage a national security risk, alleging its ownership, staffing, technology and compliance are structurally tied to China.

threads.title_zh: 【贝森特：美国本周可能查扣约 10 亿美元与伊朗相关的加密货币】
threads.title_en: 【贝森特：美国本周可能查扣约 10 亿美元与伊朗相关的加密货币】
threads.summary_zh: 美国可能本周查扣约 10 亿美元与伊朗相关的加密资产，同时将对伊政策升级为“绝对孤立”，涵盖金融制裁、海上封锁、航空限制和陆路通道切断；相关行动是否已正式实施尚不明确。
threads.summary_en: The US may seize about $1 billion in Iran-related crypto this week while escalating its Iran policy to 'absolute isolation' through sanctions, maritime blockade, aviation restrictions, and cutting land transit routes; implementation remains unconfirmed.
threads.latest_update_zh: 贝森特进一步说明对伊朗政策从“极限施压”升级为“绝对孤立”，措施包括海上封锁、限制航空运输、切断陆路通道，并与阿联酋、阿曼、巴基斯坦、土耳其协调；他还称当局已掌握拟查扣加密资产的位置。
threads.latest_update_en: Bessent further detailed escalation from 'maximum pressure' to 'absolute isolation' against Iran, including maritime blockade, aviation restrictions, land transit cuts, and coordination with UAE, Oman, Pakistan, and Turkey; he also said authorities know the location of the crypto assets to be seized.
threads.latest_summary_zh: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Washington may seize about $1 billion in crypto assets this week while escalating its Iran policy from 'maximum pressure' to 'absolute isolation' through sanctions, maritime blockade, aviation restrictions and cuts to land transit routes.
threads.latest_summary_en: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Washington may seize about $1 billion in crypto assets this week while escalating its Iran policy from 'maximum pressure' to 'absolute isolation' through sanctions, maritime blockade, aviation restrictions and cuts to land transit routes.

timeline.text_zh: 贝森特进一步说明对伊朗政策从“极限施压”升级为“绝对孤立”，措施包括海上封锁、限制航空运输、切断陆路通道，并与阿联酋、阿曼、巴基斯坦、土耳其协调；他还称当局已掌握拟查扣加密资产的位置。
timeline.text_en: Bessent further detailed escalation from 'maximum pressure' to 'absolute isolation' against Iran, including maritime blockade, aviation restrictions, land transit cuts, and coordination with UAE, Oman, Pakistan, and Turkey; he also said authorities know the location of the crypto assets to be seized.

timeline.text_zh: 美国财政部长贝森特表示，美国本周可能扣押约10亿美元与伊朗相关的加密货币，华盛顿正将其制裁行动升级为对伊朗的“绝对孤立”。
timeline.text_en: US Treasury Secretary Bessent said the US may seize about $1 billion in Iran-related cryptocurrency this week as Washington escalates its sanctions campaign into 'absolute isolation' of Iran.

threads.title_zh: Deno将加入Cloudflare
threads.title_en: Deno Is Joining Cloudflare
threads.summary_zh: Cloudflare 已聘用整个 Deno 团队，Deno 运行时进入为期一年的仅错误修复和安全更新阶段后停止官方开发；Deno Deploy 将在6个月后关闭，客户迁至 Cloudflare Workers；JSR 继续运营并迁移基础设施至 Cloudflare；Ryan Dahl 和 Bert Belder 负责将 celld 整合进 workerd。
threads.summary_en: Cloudflare has hired the entire Deno team, Deno runtime enters a one-year bug-fix and security-update-only phase before official development ceases; Deno Deploy will shut down in six months with customers migrated to Cloudflare Workers; JSR continues operating with infrastructure moving to Cloudflare; Ryan Dahl and Bert Belder are tasked with integrating celld into workerd.
threads.latest_update_zh: Deno Deploy 将于6个月后关闭，付费客户迁至 Cloudflare Workers；JSR 继续运营并将基础设施迁至 Cloudflare；Ryan Dahl 与 Bert Belder 将把 celld 的分布式 Workers/Durable Objects 能力整合进 workerd。
threads.latest_update_en: Deno Deploy will shut down in six months with paid customers migrated to Cloudflare Workers; JSR continues operating with infrastructure moving to Cloudflare; Ryan Dahl and Bert Belder will integrate celld's distributed Workers/Durable Objects capabilities into workerd.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Cloudflare has hired the entire Deno team, prompting the Deno runtime to enter a one-year error-fix and security-update-only phase before official development ceases, Deno Deploy to shut down in six months, and Ryan Dahl to focus on merging Deno's distributed celld project with Cloudflare's workerd engine.
threads.latest_summary_en: Cloudflare has hired the entire Deno team, prompting the Deno runtime to enter a one-year error-fix and security-update-only phase before official development ceases, Deno Deploy to shut down in six months, and Ryan Dahl to focus on merging Deno's distributed celld project with Cloudflare's workerd engine.

timeline.text_zh: Deno Deploy 将于6个月后关闭，付费客户迁至 Cloudflare Workers；JSR 继续运营并将基础设施迁至 Cloudflare；Ryan Dahl 与 Bert Belder 将把 celld 的分布式 Workers/Durable Objects 能力整合进 workerd。
timeline.text_en: Deno Deploy will shut down in six months with paid customers migrated to Cloudflare Workers; JSR continues operating with infrastructure moving to Cloudflare; Ryan Dahl and Bert Belder will integrate celld's distributed Workers/Durable Objects capabilities into workerd.

timeline.text_zh: Cloudflare正在收购Deno，Deno自身的运行时开发将逐步收尾，先进行为期一年的每月漏洞修复和安全更新，随后结束，项目将保持开源，但不再由其原团队提供支持。
timeline.text_en: Cloudflare is acquiring Deno, and Deno's own runtime development will wind down to a year of monthly bug-fix and security releases before ending, leaving the project open source but unsupported by its original team.

threads.title_zh: FT：DWF Labs就涉嫌提前出售锁定代币起诉BitGo，索赔1.41亿美元
threads.title_en: FT: DWF Labs Sues BitGo for $141 Million Over Alleged Early Sales of Locked Toke
threads.summary_zh: DWF Labs 旗下 DWF Maas 与 Falcon Digital 在伦敦起诉 BitGo，索赔 1.41 亿美元；其称 BitGo 在三个月锁仓期到期前出售折价 FF 和 ESPORTS 代币，并寻求 1.14 亿美元损害赔偿。
threads.summary_en: DWF Labs subsidiaries DWF Maas and Falcon Digital sued BitGo in London seeking $141 million; they allege BitGo sold discounted FF and ESPORTS tokens before three-month lock-ups expired and seek $114 million in damages.
threads.latest_update_zh: 披露原告为 DWF Maas 与 Falcon Digital，并明确索赔 1.14 亿美元损害赔偿及三个月锁仓期等细节。
threads.latest_update_en: Disclosed plaintiffs DWF Maas and Falcon Digital, specified $114 million in damages sought and three-month lock-up periods.
threads.latest_summary_zh: DWF Labs subsidiaries DWF Maas and Falcon Digital sued BitGo in London for $141 million, alleging the custodian sold discounted FF and ESPORTS tokens before their three-month lock-ups expired and seeking $114 million in damages for resulting price declines.
threads.latest_summary_en: DWF Labs subsidiaries DWF Maas and Falcon Digital sued BitGo in London for $141 million, alleging the custodian sold discounted FF and ESPORTS tokens before their three-month lock-ups expired and seeking $114 million in damages for resulting price declines.

timeline.text_zh: 披露原告为 DWF Maas 与 Falcon Digital，并明确索赔 1.14 亿美元损害赔偿及三个月锁仓期等细节。
timeline.text_en: Disclosed plaintiffs DWF Maas and Falcon Digital, specified $114 million in damages sought and three-month lock-up periods.

timeline.text_zh: DWF Labs关联公司在伦敦高等法院起诉加密托管机构BitGo，索赔1.41亿美元，指控BitGo在约定的锁定期和归属期之前出售Falcon Finance和ESPORTS代币，压低了价格和DWF剩余持仓的价值。
timeline.text_en: DWF Labs affiliates sued crypto custodian BitGo in London's High Court for $141 million, alleging BitGo sold Falcon Finance and ESPORTS tokens ahead of agreed lock-up and vesting periods, depressing prices and DWF's remaining holdings.

threads.title_zh: Bitget 遭朝鲜关联黑客攻击，约3.88亿美元被盗
threads.title_en: Bitget Suffers DPRK-Linked Hack with Roughly $388M Stolen
threads.summary_zh: Chainalysis 将 3.87 亿美元的 Bitget 黑客攻击归因于与朝鲜有关的黑客，使 2026 年归因于朝鲜的加密货币盗窃金额超过 10 亿美元，链上记录显示被盗的 XRP 通过 THORChain 进行兑换；Chainalysis 使用内部 AI 加速追踪，且新报道补充 Near Intents 拒绝超 5000 万美元相关兑换后自身遭攻击、THORChain 继续处理、Circle 和 Tether 冻结约 31.8 万美元稳定币。
threads.summary_en: Chainalysis attributes the $387 million Bitget hack to North Korea-linked hackers, bringing DPRK-attributed crypto theft above $1 billion in 2026, with on-chain records showing the stolen XRP being swapped through THORChain; Chainalysis used in-house AI to accelerate tracing, and reporting adds that Near Intents rejected over $50M in related swaps before being hacked, THORChain kept processing, and Circle and Tether froze about $318k in stablecoins.
threads.latest_update_zh: Chainalysis 使用内部 AI 加速追踪，将 20 多小时的手动跨链对账压缩至 10 分钟以内；新报道还补充了 Near Intents 拒绝超 5000 万美元相关兑换后自身遭攻击、THORChain 继续处理、Circle 和 Tether 冻结约 31.8 万美元稳定币等洗钱应对细节。
threads.latest_update_en: Chainalysis used in-house AI to accelerate tracing, compressing 20+ hours of manual bridge reconciliation into under 10 minutes; the report also adds laundering response details: Near Intents rejected over $50M in related swaps before being hacked itself, THORChain kept processing, and Circle and Tether froze about $318,000 in stablecoins.
threads.background_zh: 转账之后，攻击者通过跨链流动性与消息协议、即时兑换以及洗钱服务转移资金，以掩盖踪迹。被盗的 XRP 被送入一个跨链流动性协议，另一端换出比特币，约一天半时间内数千万美元资金流向目前正被监控的攻击者控制的比特币地址；攻击者还开始将资金藏入 Zcash 的屏蔽池。Near Intents 拒绝了与黑客相关的逾 5000 万美元兑换，几天后自身也遭到攻击，而 Thorchain 继续处理相关交易；Circle 与 Tether 合计冻结了约 31.8 万美元的稳定币。
threads.background_en: After the transfers, the attackers ran the funds through cross-chain liquidity and messaging protocols, instant swaps and laundering services to obscure the trail. The stolen XRP was pushed through a cross-chain liquidity protocol with Bitcoin pulled out the other side, moving tens of millions of dollars over roughly a day and a half to attacker-controlled Bitcoin addresses now under watch, and the attacker began hiding funds in Zcash's shielded pool. Near Intents rejected more than $50 million in swaps tied to the hacker and was itself hacked days later, while Thorchain kept processing; Circle and Tether froze roughly $318,000 in stablecoins.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Chainalysis attributed the $387 million Bitget exchange hack to North Korea-linked actors, using in-house AI to trace the funds across 23 rapid transfers into Ethereum, XRP, Zcash and Tron, pushing Pyongyang's 2026 crypto theft total past $1 billion.
threads.latest_summary_en: Chainalysis attributed the $387 million Bitget exchange hack to North Korea-linked actors, using in-house AI to trace the funds across 23 rapid transfers into Ethereum, XRP, Zcash and Tron, pushing Pyongyang's 2026 crypto theft total past $1 billion.
threads.market_impact_zh: 该事件使交易所热钱包安全以及跨链桥／兑换洗钱路径持续受到关注，也显示 Circle、Tether 等稳定币发行方能够冻结与被追踪资金相关的余额，这一渠道会影响中心化交易平台的托管与流动性风险，以及用于转移被盗资产的跨链桥与即时兑换服务。Chainalysis 关于 AI 辅助追踪的说法，也关系到合规与分析服务商能以多快速度标记受污染资金流。
threads.market_impact_en: The case keeps exchange hot-wallet security and cross-chain bridge/swap laundering routes in focus, and shows that stablecoin issuers such as Circle and Tether can freeze balances tied to traced funds — a channel that affects custody and liquidity risk for centralized venues and for the bridge and instant-swap services used to move stolen assets. Chainalysis's AI-assisted tracing claim also bears on how quickly tainted flows can be flagged by compliance and analytics providers.

timeline.text_en: Chainalysis used in-house AI to accelerate tracing, compressing 20+ hours of manual bridge reconciliation into under 10 minutes; the report also adds laundering response details: Near Intents rejected over $50M in related swaps before being hacked itself, THORChain kept processing, and Circle and Tether froze about $318,000 in stablecoins.

timeline.text_zh: Chainalysis 将 3.87 亿美元的 Bitget 黑客攻击归因于与朝鲜有关的黑客，使 2026 年归因于朝鲜的加密货币盗窃金额超过 10 亿美元，链上记录显示被盗的 XRP 通过 THORChain 进行兑换。
timeline.text_en: Chainalysis attributes the $387 million Bitget hack to North Korea-linked hackers, bringing DPRK-attributed crypto theft above $1 billion in 2026, with on-chain records showing the stolen XRP being swapped through THORChain.

timeline.text_zh: Galaxy Research 分析 Bitget 黑客攻击，显示其遵循了此前在 Bybit 入侵事件中出现的与 Lazarus 相关的相同攻击模式。
timeline.text_en: Galaxy Research analyzes the Bitget hack, showing it follows the same Lazarus-linked attack pattern previously seen in the Bybit breach.

threads.title_zh: Hyperliquid Labs 解质押并场外出售 375 万枚 HYPE
threads.title_en: Hyperliquid Labs Unstakes and Sells 3.75M HYPE via OTC
threads.summary_zh: HyperLabs OTC出售375万枚HYPE的买家身份仍未知，PURR已否认参与；此前链上数据显示资金归集至疑为OTC买家的地址0x875...1d1。
threads.summary_en: The buyer of HyperLabs' 3.75M HYPE OTC sale remains unknown; PURR has denied involvement; on-chain data previously showed funds consolidated to a suspected OTC buyer address 0x875...1d1.
threads.latest_update_zh: PURR CEO David Schamis公开否认其公司是Hyperliquid Labs 375万枚HYPE OTC交易的买家。
threads.latest_update_en: PURR CEO David Schamis publicly denied that his company was the buyer of Hyperliquid Labs' 3.75M HYPE OTC sale.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Hyperliquid Strategies DAT (PURR) CEO David Schamis publicly denied that his HYPE treasury company was the buyer of the 3.75 million HYPE (~$320M) that the Hyperliquid Labs team sold over the counter.
threads.latest_summary_en: Hyperliquid Strategies DAT (PURR) CEO David Schamis publicly denied that his HYPE treasury company was the buyer of the 3.75 million HYPE (~$320M) that the Hyperliquid Labs team sold over the counter.

timeline.text_zh: PURR CEO David Schamis公开否认其公司是Hyperliquid Labs 375万枚HYPE OTC交易的买家。
timeline.text_en: PURR CEO David Schamis publicly denied that his company was the buyer of Hyperliquid Labs' 3.75M HYPE OTC sale.

timeline.text_zh: 链上监测显示HyperLabs赎回并分发的375万枚HYPE最终归集至疑为OTC买家的机构地址，其中125万枚被重新质押，250万枚仍留在钱包中。
timeline.text_en: On-chain monitoring shows HyperLabs' redeemed and distributed 3.75M HYPE ultimately consolidated to a suspected OTC buyer institutional address, with 1.25M HYPE re-staked and 2.5M HYPE still held in wallets.

timeline.text_zh: HyperLabs已完成375万枚HYPE的解质押，价值约3.3亿美元，并已将187.5万枚HYPE（50%）分发给五个OTC买家钱包，每个37.5万枚，这些代币流向一位未披露的机构买家，而非公开市场。
timeline.text_en: HyperLabs completed unstaking 3.75M HYPE worth roughly $330M and has distributed 1.875M HYPE (50%) to five OTC buyer wallets at 375,000 each, with the tokens going to an undisclosed institutional buyer rather than the open market.

threads.title_zh: ⚡️美媒：美军已被要求做好对伊朗恢复打击的准备
threads.title_en: ⚡️美媒：美军已被要求做好对伊朗恢复打击的准备
threads.summary_zh: 美国官员称五角大楼已指示中央司令部准备恢复对伊朗的大规模军事行动，可能打击伊朗能源、基础设施和核设施；同时特朗普公开承诺不在中期选举前打击伊朗，但美军据报已向以色列通报可能月底前恢复行动，美伊谈判持续且美国维持封锁。
threads.summary_en: US officials say the Pentagon has instructed CENTCOM to prepare for resuming large-scale military operations against Iran, potentially targeting Iranian energy, infrastructure, and nuclear facilities; meanwhile Trump publicly pledged no strikes before the midterm elections, but the US military reportedly told Israel that operations could resume by the end of October, with US-Iran talks ongoing and the US maintaining its blockade.
threads.latest_update_zh: 特朗普承诺美国不会在11月3日中期选举前打击伊朗；美军据报已向以色列国防军总参谋长通报可能在本月底前恢复对伊军事行动；若恢复打击，伊朗可能报复以色列并导致以色列选举推迟；美伊谈判被描述为富有成效，美国维持对伊封锁。
threads.latest_update_en: Trump pledged the US will not strike Iran before the Nov 3 midterm elections; the US military reportedly told Israel's military chief that operations against Iran could resume by the end of October; if strikes resume, Iran may retaliate against Israel and delay Israel's election; US-Iran talks described as productive; US maintains blockade on Iran.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Trump pledged the US will not strike Iran before the November 3 midterm elections, even as reports say the US military has told Israel's military chief that operations against Iran—potentially targeting energy and nuclear sites—could resume by the end of October.
threads.latest_summary_en: Trump pledged the US will not strike Iran before the November 3 midterm elections, even as reports say the US military has told Israel's military chief that operations against Iran—potentially targeting energy and nuclear sites—could resume by the end of October.

timeline.text_zh: 特朗普承诺美国不会在11月3日中期选举前打击伊朗；美军据报已向以色列国防军总参谋长通报可能在本月底前恢复对伊军事行动；若恢复打击，伊朗可能报复以色列并导致以色列选举推迟；美伊谈判被描述为富有成效，美国维持对伊封锁。
timeline.text_en: Trump pledged the US will not strike Iran before the Nov 3 midterm elections; the US military reportedly told Israel's military chief that operations against Iran could resume by the end of October; if strikes resume, Iran may retaliate against Israel and delay Israel's election; US-Iran talks described as productive; US maintains blockade on Iran.

timeline.text_zh: 美国官员称，五角大楼已指示中央司令部准备恢复对伊朗的大规模军事行动，消息人士暗示打击可能在美国中期选举前发生，目标是伊朗的能源、基础设施和核设施。
timeline.text_en: US officials say the Pentagon has instructed CENTCOM to prepare for resuming large-scale military operations against Iran, with sources suggesting strikes could occur before the US midterm elections, targeting Iranian energy, infrastructure, and nuclear facilities.

threads.title_zh: Anthropic发布Claude Haiku 5.5：价格降90%，多项评测超过GPT-6 Luna
threads.title_en: Anthropic发布Claude Haiku 5.5：价格降90%，多项评测超过GPT-6 Luna
threads.summary_zh: Anthropic已发布Claude Haiku 5.5，独立评测显示其综合智能指数43分，超过GPT-6 Luna的38分，但最高推理档token消耗与成本更高；市场反应方面，智谱和MiniMax股价因竞争压力大跌。
threads.summary_en: Anthropic has launched Claude Haiku 5.5; independent evaluation shows a composite intelligence index score of 43, ahead of GPT-6 Luna's 38, but with higher token usage and cost at max effort; in market reaction, Zhipu and MiniMax shares dropped significantly on competitive pressure.
threads.latest_update_zh: 受Claude Haiku 5.5发布带来的定价与性能竞争压力影响，港股大模型公司智谱和MiniMax股价盘中分别下跌超过6%和9%。
threads.latest_update_en: Amid competitive pricing and performance pressure from the Claude Haiku 5.5 launch, Hong Kong-listed Zhipu and MiniMax shares fell more than 6% and 9% intraday.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Anthropic's Claude Haiku 5.5 launch undercuts Chinese low-cost models on API pricing and tops comparable Artificial Analysis/Terminal-Bench scores, sending Hong Kong-listed Zhipu and MiniMax shares down more than 6% and 9% respectively.
threads.latest_summary_en: Anthropic's Claude Haiku 5.5 launch undercuts Chinese low-cost models on API pricing and tops comparable Artificial Analysis/Terminal-Bench scores, sending Hong Kong-listed Zhipu and MiniMax shares down more than 6% and 9% respectively.

timeline.text_zh: 受Claude Haiku 5.5发布带来的定价与性能竞争压力影响，港股大模型公司智谱和MiniMax股价盘中分别下跌超过6%和9%。
timeline.text_en: Amid competitive pricing and performance pressure from the Claude Haiku 5.5 launch, Hong Kong-listed Zhipu and MiniMax shares fell more than 6% and 9% intraday.

timeline.text_zh: 第三方评测机构Artificial Analysis公布Claude Haiku 5.5独立评测结果：综合智能指数43分，超GPT-6 Luna的38分，但最高推理档每任务输出约16.2万tokens，为Luna的3.2倍，预估单任务成本约0.21美元 vs Luna的0.07美元；high档得分38分且token用量接近Luna。
timeline.text_en: Artificial Analysis released independent evaluation results for Claude Haiku 5.5: composite intelligence index score of 43, ahead of GPT-6 Luna's 38, but at maximum reasoning effort it outputs about 162k tokens per task (3.2x Luna) with estimated per-task cost around $0.21 vs Luna's $0.07; at high effort it scores 38 with token usage close to Luna.

timeline.text_zh: Anthropic发布Claude Haiku 5.5，这是一款面向智能体的轻量级模型，API价格降低90%，并声称在计算机使用、专业工作和编程评估中基准测试成绩超过GPT-6 Luna。
timeline.text_en: Anthropic launched Claude Haiku 5.5, a lightweight agent-focused model that cuts API prices by 90% and claims benchmark wins over GPT-6 Luna in computer-use, professional-work, and coding evaluations.

threads.title_zh: Solana 生态 Orca 与 Loopscale 合并为 Formation
threads.title_en: Solana's Orca and Loopscale Merge to Form Formation
threads.summary_zh: Orca 与 Loopscale 已完成合并并以 Formation 名义运营，由 Luke Truitt 任 CEO；Formation 总部位于纽约，计划为 AI、能源、机器人、国防资产提供融资，并在 12 个月内推出基于 SEC 创新豁免的代币化证券场所；ORCA 将作为整个 Formation 的代币，Loopscale 积分继续累积并将在今年晚些时候转换。
threads.summary_en: Orca and Loopscale have completed their merger and operate under the Formation brand, led by CEO Luke Truitt; Formation is headquartered in New York, plans to finance AI, energy, robotics, and defense assets, and intends to launch a tokenized securities venue under the SEC Innovation Exemption within 12 months; ORCA will serve as the token for all of Formation, while Loopscale points keep accruing and will convert later this year.
threads.latest_update_zh: Formation 总部位于纽约；计划为 AI、能源、机器人、国防资产提供融资，并在 12 个月内根据 SEC 创新豁免推出代币化证券场所；ORCA 将作为整个 Formation 的代币，Loopscale 积分继续累积并将在今年晚些时候转换；管理层增加 Mary Gooneratne 任 COO、Christopher Montagano 任首席战略与法务官。
threads.latest_update_en: Formation is headquartered in New York; plans to finance AI, energy, robotics, and defense assets and to launch a tokenized securities venue under the SEC Innovation Exemption within 12 months; ORCA will serve as the token for all of Formation, Loopscale points keep accruing and will convert later this year; management adds Mary Gooneratne as COO and Christopher Montagano as chief strategy and legal officer.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Solana DEX Orca and lending protocol Loopscale are merging into a New York-based company called Formation, which plans to finance AI, energy, robotics and defense assets and to launch a tokenized securities venue under the SEC Innovation Exemption within 12 months.
threads.latest_summary_en: Solana DEX Orca and lending protocol Loopscale are merging into a New York-based company called Formation, which plans to finance AI, energy, robotics and defense assets and to launch a tokenized securities venue under the SEC Innovation Exemption within 12 months.

timeline.text_zh: Formation 总部位于纽约；计划为 AI、能源、机器人、国防资产提供融资，并在 12 个月内根据 SEC 创新豁免推出代币化证券场所；ORCA 将作为整个 Formation 的代币，Loopscale 积分继续累积并将在今年晚些时候转换；管理层增加 Mary Gooneratne 任 COO、Christopher Montagano 任首席战略与法务官。
timeline.text_en: Formation is headquartered in New York; plans to finance AI, energy, robotics, and defense assets and to launch a tokenized securities venue under the SEC Innovation Exemption within 12 months; ORCA will serve as the token for all of Formation, Loopscale points keep accruing and will convert later this year; management adds Mary Gooneratne as COO and Christopher Montagano as chief strategy and legal officer.

timeline.text_zh: Solana 流动性协议 Orca 与链上借贷协议 Loopscale 已完成合并，将以新名称 Formation 运营，由 Loopscale 联合创始人 Luke Truitt 出任 CEO，将交易/流动性基础设施与信贷和托管基础设施相结合，为资产提供从发行到融资和流动性的端到端路径。
timeline.text_en: Solana liquidity protocol Orca and on-chain lending protocol Loopscale have completed a merger and will operate under the new name Formation, led by Loopscale co-founder Luke Truitt as CEO, combining trading/liquidity infrastructure with credit and custody infrastructure to offer assets an end-to-end path from issuance to financing and liquidity.

timeline.text_zh: Solana 去中心化交易所 Orca 和借贷协议 Loopscale 正在合并为一家名为 Formation 的新实体，将交易基础设施与借贷和资金库产品相结合，并计划在未来一年向 AI、能源、机器人和国防垂直领域扩张。
timeline.text_en: Solana DEX Orca and lending protocol Loopscale are merging into a new entity called Formation, combining trading infrastructure with lending and vault products and planning expansion into AI, energy, robotics and defense verticals over the next year.

threads.title_zh: 新泽西州请求美国最高法院裁定预测市场体育博彩监管权归属
threads.title_en: New Jersey asks Supreme Court to decide who regulates sports betting on prediction markets
threads.summary_zh: 新泽西州已请求美国最高法院裁定预测市场上的体育博彩应由州还是联邦监管；NFL提交法庭之友意见书支持最高法院受理该案，并主张Kalshi体育合约为赌博。
threads.summary_en: New Jersey has asked the U.S. Supreme Court to decide whether sports betting on prediction markets should be regulated by states or federal authorities; the NFL filed an amicus brief supporting Supreme Court review and arguing Kalshi's sports contracts are gambling.
threads.latest_update_zh: NFL提交法庭之友意见书，敦促美国最高法院受理新泽西州的挑战，并主张Kalshi的体育合约属于赌博而非受CFTC监管的掉期。
threads.latest_update_en: The NFL filed an amicus brief urging the U.S. Supreme Court to take up New Jersey's challenge and arguing that Kalshi's sports contracts are gambling rather than CFTC-regulated swaps.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The NFL filed an amicus brief urging the Supreme Court to take up New Jersey's challenge and rule that Kalshi's sports contracts constitute gambling rather than CFTC-regulated swaps.
threads.latest_summary_en: The NFL filed an amicus brief urging the Supreme Court to take up New Jersey's challenge and rule that Kalshi's sports contracts constitute gambling rather than CFTC-regulated swaps.

timeline.text_zh: NFL提交法庭之友意见书，敦促美国最高法院受理新泽西州的挑战，并主张Kalshi的体育合约属于赌博而非受CFTC监管的掉期。
timeline.text_en: The NFL filed an amicus brief urging the U.S. Supreme Court to take up New Jersey's challenge and arguing that Kalshi's sports contracts are gambling rather than CFTC-regulated swaps.

timeline.text_zh: 新泽西州已请求美国最高法院裁定预测市场上的体育博彩应由各州还是联邦当局监管。
timeline.text_en: New Jersey has asked the U.S. Supreme Court to decide whether sports betting on prediction markets should be regulated by states or federal authorities.

threads.title_zh: Consensys与ClearToken达成合作，将为批发金融市场提供全天候结算基础设施
threads.title_en: Consensys与ClearToken达成合作，将为批发金融市场提供全天候结算基础设施
threads.summary_zh: Consensys与ClearToken的合作维持，提供代币化证券与法币、代币化存款及稳定币之间的全天候DvP结算基础设施；ClearToken旗下CSD已获英国央行数字证券沙盒Gate 2批准，可在限额内运营数字证券存管，但清算业务仍须英国央行授权。
threads.summary_en: The Consensys-ClearToken partnership remains in place to provide round-the-clock DvP settlement between tokenized securities and fiat, tokenized deposits, and stablecoins; ClearToken's CSD has received Bank of England Digital Securities Sandbox Gate 2 approval to operate a limited digital securities depository, while clearing operations still require Bank of England authorization.
threads.latest_update_zh: ClearToken旗下中央证券存管机构获得英国央行数字证券沙盒Gate 2批准，可在限额内运营数字证券存管；清算业务仍须英国央行授权。
threads.latest_update_en: ClearToken's CSD received Bank of England Digital Securities Sandbox Gate 2 approval to operate a limited digital securities depository; clearing operations still require Bank of England authorization.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Consensys partnered with UK digital-asset market infrastructure firm ClearToken to provide round-the-clock DvP settlement between tokenized securities and fiat, tokenized deposits and stablecoins, with ClearToken's CSD having won Bank of England Digital Securities Sandbox Gate 2 approval for limited digital securities depository operations.
threads.latest_summary_en: Consensys partnered with UK digital-asset market infrastructure firm ClearToken to provide round-the-clock DvP settlement between tokenized securities and fiat, tokenized deposits and stablecoins, with ClearToken's CSD having won Bank of England Digital Securities Sandbox Gate 2 approval for limited digital securities depository operations.

timeline.text_zh: ClearToken旗下中央证券存管机构获得英国央行数字证券沙盒Gate 2批准，可在限额内运营数字证券存管；清算业务仍须英国央行授权。
timeline.text_en: ClearToken's CSD received Bank of England Digital Securities Sandbox Gate 2 approval to operate a limited digital securities depository; clearing operations still require Bank of England authorization.

timeline.text_zh: Consensys 与 ClearToken 宣布建立战略合作伙伴关系，为批发市场提供全天候的 DvP 结算基础设施，在英格兰银行的数字证券沙盒下对符合条件的银行证券进行代币化，并以法币、代币化存款和稳定币进行结算。
timeline.text_en: Consensys and ClearToken announced a strategic partnership to deliver round-the-clock DvP settlement infrastructure for wholesale markets, tokenizing eligible bank securities under the Bank of England's Digital Securities Sandbox and settling against fiat, tokenized deposits, and stablecoins.

threads.title_zh: 加密早报：Abstract 宣布分阶段关停，Coinbase 计划年底前重新推出 Coinbase Pro
threads.title_en: Crypto Morning Briefing: Abstract Announces Phased Shutdown, Coinbase Plans to Relaunch Coinbase Pro by Year-End

threads.title_zh: 德国监管机构拒绝 MiCA 申请，Bitcoin.de 交易仍处暂停状态
threads.title_en: Bitcoin.de trading remains halted as German regulator rejects MiCA application
threads.summary_zh: BaFin 拒绝了 Futurum Bank AG 的 MiCA 申请，Bitcoin.de 自 6 月 12 日起交易基本暂停，欧元存款暂停，但加密资产提现仍开放。平台计划将交易和托管外包给两家未具名的受监管德国合作方，Futurum Bank 将在资产转移前继续持有资产；无恢复日期，公司可在一个月内提出异议或重新申请。
threads.summary_en: BaFin rejected Futurum Bank AG's MiCA application, leaving Bitcoin.de trading largely suspended since June 12 and euro deposits halted, while crypto withdrawals remain open. The platform plans to outsource trading and custody to two unidentified regulated German partners, with Futurum Bank continuing to hold assets until transfer; no restart date is set, and the company may object within one month or reapply.
threads.latest_update_zh: BaFin 拒绝后，Bitcoin.de 计划通过两家受监管的德国机构重建交易和托管模式：一家作为交易对手方，另一家负责加密资产托管；平台保留应用、品牌和客户界面。客户仍可提取加密资产，但交易和欧元存款暂停，合作方尚未公布，恢复服务无确定日期；公司可在一个月内提出异议，也可能重新申请授权。
threads.latest_update_en: After BaFin's rejection, Bitcoin.de plans to rebuild trading and custody through two regulated German institutions: one as trading counterparty and one for crypto custody, while retaining its app, brand and customer interface. Withdrawals remain open, but trading and euro deposits are suspended; the partners are unidentified, no restart date is set, and the company may object within one month or reapply for authorization.
threads.latest_summary_zh: German regulator BaFin rejected Bitcoin.de operator Futurum Bank's MiCA crypto-asset service provider application, forcing the 1.1 million-user platform to dismantle and rebuild its trading and custody model around external regulated partners while withdrawals remain open and trading stays suspended.
threads.latest_summary_en: German regulator BaFin rejected Bitcoin.de operator Futurum Bank's MiCA crypto-asset service provider application, forcing the 1.1 million-user platform to dismantle and rebuild its trading and custody model around external regulated partners while withdrawals remain open and trading stays suspended.

timeline.text_zh: BaFin 拒绝后，Bitcoin.de 计划通过两家受监管的德国机构重建交易和托管模式：一家作为交易对手方，另一家负责加密资产托管；平台保留应用、品牌和客户界面。客户仍可提取加密资产，但交易和欧元存款暂停，合作方尚未公布，恢复服务无确定日期；公司可在一个月内提出异议，也可能重新申请授权。
timeline.text_en: After BaFin's rejection, Bitcoin.de plans to rebuild trading and custody through two regulated German institutions: one as trading counterparty and one for crypto custody, while retaining its app, brand and customer interface. Withdrawals remain open, but trading and euro deposits are suspended; the partners are unidentified, no restart date is set, and the company may object within one month or reapply for authorization.

timeline.text_zh: 德国监管机构 BaFin 拒绝了 Bitcoin Group SE 子公司 futurum bank AG 的 MiCA 加密资产服务提供商授权，导致 bitcoin.de 自 6 月以来交易基本暂停，该公司正通过受监管合作伙伴寻求替代模式。
timeline.text_en: German regulator BaFin rejected Bitcoin Group SE subsidiary futurum bank AG's MiCA crypto-asset service provider authorization, leaving bitcoin.de trading largely suspended since June while the company pursues an alternative model through regulated partners.

threads.summary_en: Coinbase has appealed a Connecticut court ruling over its sports event contracts, escalating its jurisdictional fight with state regulators over whether prediction-market style products fall under federal derivatives oversight or state gaming law.

timeline.text_zh: Coinbase 与密歇根州博彩控制委员会达成和解，同意停止提供与体育相关的赛事合约，在围绕预测市场产品的持续争议中向州博彩监管机构作出让步。
timeline.text_en: Coinbase settled with the Michigan Gaming Control Board and agreed to stop offering sports-related event contracts, conceding to state gaming regulators in the ongoing dispute over prediction-market products.

threads.title_zh: 币安上线 bStocks 代币化证券交易对
threads.title_en: Binance Lists bStocks Tokenized Securities Trading Pairs
threads.summary_zh:
币安发布公告称，将于 10 月 7 日 20:00 上线四个 bStocks 代币化证券交易对：JPMB/USDT、LLYB/USDT、SECZB/USDT 和 USDEB/USDT。现货算法交易机器人与现货上市同时启用，智能持仓机器人将在上线后 24 小时内启用，上线后一小时内可免手续费兑换为 BTC、USDT 或其他支持代币，零挂单手续费活动持续至 11 月 1 日 07:59。

此次上线把四个代币化股票交易对纳入币安现货市场，并在上市同时启用交易机器人、提供免手续费兑换窗口，扩展了该交易所的代币化证券产品线。币安同时提示，bStocks 服务及其功能因司法辖区而异，部分市场的用户无法使用。

bStocks 为代币化证券，每份由托管于受监管托管机构的 1 股美国股票 1:1 支撑，可在币安现货市场 24 小时交易。现货算法机器人与交易对同步上线，智能持仓机器人在 24 小时内跟进；零挂单手续费适用于 11 月 1 日 07:59 之前。
threads.summary_en: Binance announced it will list bStocks tokenized-securities pairs JPMB/USDT, LLYB/USDT, SECZB/USDT and USDEB/USDT on October 7 at 20:00, enabling spot algo trading bots at launch, smart holding bots within 24 hours, free conversion to BTC/USDT or other supported tokens in the first hour, and zero maker fees until November 1.

The zero-maker-fee window and one-hour free conversion into BTC/USDT can shift short-term order flow between the new bStocks pairs and major crypto pairs on Binance, though jurisdictional restrictions limit who can access the products.

threads.title_zh: Zcash NU7 治理提案获批并推进主网升级
threads.title_en: Zcash NU7 governance approved and mainnet upgrade advanced
threads.summary_zh: NU7 已在公共测试网激活，主网启动目标为 11 月 5 日，最终激活决定待 10 月 20 日审查测试结果后作出。
threads.summary_en: NU7 is now active on public testnet, with mainnet launch targeted for Nov. 5, pending a final activation decision after test result review on Oct. 20.
threads.latest_update_zh: Zcash 的 NU7 升级已在公共测试网上激活，区块目标时间从 75 秒缩短至 25 秒，比原计划提前；60% 的交易手续费被转入未来挖矿奖励储备；旧版 Sprout 隐私系统被禁用。主网计划于 11 月 5 日启动，开发者将于 10 月 20 日审查测试结果后决定激活。
threads.latest_update_en: Zcash's NU7 upgrade activated on public testnet, cutting target block time from 75 seconds to 25 seconds ahead of schedule; 60% of transaction fees redirected to a future mining reward reserve; legacy Sprout privacy system disabled. Mainnet planned for Nov. 5, with developers to review test results and decide on activation Oct. 20.
threads.background_zh: NU7 是 Zcash 的第七次网络升级。若如其预期包含重大共识变更，zcashd 将不支持该升级，运营方需要迁移至 Zcash 基金会开发的 Zebra 共识节点。Sprout 是 Zcash 最早的隐私支付系统，而「网络可持续性机制」针对的是 Zcash 在 2100 万枚供应上限下依赖区块奖励维持网络安全这一问题。
threads.background_en: NU7 is Zcash's seventh network upgrade. If it includes major consensus changes as expected, it will not be supported by zcashd, so operators need to upgrade to the Zebra consensus node developed by the Zcash Foundation. Sprout is Zcash's oldest private-payment system, and the Network Sustainability Mechanism is aimed at the fact that Zcash's network security is funded by block rewards under a 21 million coin supply cap.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Zcash activated its NU7 upgrade on public testnet, cutting targeted block times to 25 seconds from 75 ahead of a planned Nov. 5 mainnet launch, while redirecting 60% of transaction fees to a mining-reward reserve and disabling the legacy Sprout privacy system.
threads.latest_summary_en: Zcash activated its NU7 upgrade on public testnet, cutting targeted block times to 25 seconds from 75 ahead of a planned Nov. 5 mainnet launch, while redirecting 60% of transaction fees to a mining-reward reserve and disabling the legacy Sprout privacy system.
threads.market_impact_zh: ZEC 是直接受影响的资产，传导路径主要通过交易平台入账与钱包基础设施——目标出块间隔缩短会改变上币与结算平台的确认等待时间。Sprout 池停用以及 60% 手续费转入储备，也会影响流通供应与矿工收入结构；仍运行 zcashd 相关软件的运营方需要兼容节点才能跟随升级后的链。
threads.market_impact_en: ZEC is the directly exposed asset, with transmission running through exchange deposit-crediting and wallet infrastructure, since a shorter target block interval changes confirmation waits for venues that list and settle the coin. The Sprout cut-off and the redirection of 60% of transaction fees into a reserve also alter circulating-supply and miner-revenue mechanics, and operators running zcashd-based software would need compatible nodes to follow the upgraded chain.

timeline.text_zh: Zcash 的 NU7 升级已在公共测试网上激活，区块目标时间从 75 秒缩短至 25 秒，比原计划提前；60% 的交易手续费被转入未来挖矿奖励储备；旧版 Sprout 隐私系统被禁用。主网计划于 11 月 5 日启动，开发者将于 10 月 20 日审查测试结果后决定激活。
timeline.text_en: Zcash's NU7 upgrade activated on public testnet, cutting target block time from 75 seconds to 25 seconds ahead of schedule; 60% of transaction fees redirected to a future mining reward reserve; legacy Sprout privacy system disabled. Mainnet planned for Nov. 5, with developers to review test results and decide on activation Oct. 20.

timeline.text_zh: Zcash 已在测试网区块高度 4,465,026 激活 NU7 升级（该高度于 10 月 4 日 18:21:45 UTC 完成出块），比原计划的 10 月 6 日测试网上线提前落地，实测 25 秒目标出块间隔、禁用版本 4 交易并引入手续费重定向的网络可持续性机制。
timeline.text_en: Zcash activated NU7 on testnet at block height 4,465,026 (mined Oct. 4 at 18:21:45 UTC), landing ahead of the previously scheduled Oct. 6 testnet launch, with live testing of the 25-second target block interval, version 4 transaction disablement, and the fee-redirecting Network Sustainability Mechanism.

timeline.text_zh: NU7 升级将依据 ZIP-2003 禁用版本 4 交易，导致遗留 Sprout 屏蔽池中的 ZEC 在升级后无法花费；社区成员和 Zcash 联合创始人 Zooko Wilcox 警告持币者尽快迁移资金，但提案并未销毁这些资金，未来仍有可能恢复访问。
timeline.text_en: NU7 will disable version 4 transactions under ZIP-2003, making ZEC in the legacy Sprout shielded pool unspendable after the upgrade; community members and Zcash co-founder Zooko Wilcox warned holders to move funds, though the proposal does not burn the funds and leaves open the possibility of restoring access later.

threads.title_zh: Base 上金库遭攻击，约 1783 枚 wstETH 被盗
threads.title_en: Base vault attacked, ~1,783 wstETH drained
threads.summary_zh: Base 上一未认领金库合约遭攻击，约 600 万美元（约 1783 枚 wstETH）通过 Safe 多签白名单机制与 Aave V3 赎回被盗；攻击者通过六笔资金流出完成抽资，部分资金已跨链桥转向以太坊；该金库内仍有约 3170 万美元资产处于风险中，Aave 核心合约和 Base 链本身未受影响。
threads.summary_en: An unclaimed vault contract on Base was attacked, with ~$6M (~1,783 wstETH) drained via a Safe multisig whitelist mechanism and Aave V3 redemption; the attacker executed six outflows and some funds were bridged toward Ethereum; ~$31.7M in assets remain at risk in the vault, while Aave core contracts and Base itself were unaffected.
threads.latest_update_zh: 链上数据显示，攻击者先将新部署的合约移出金库借款方白名单，约一分钟后重新加入，随后发生六笔未经授权的资金流出；部分被盗资金经跨链桥转向以太坊。
threads.latest_update_en: On-chain data shows the attacker removed a newly deployed contract from the vault's borrower whitelist, added it back about one minute later, then executed six unauthorized outflows; some stolen funds were bridged toward Ethereum.
threads.background_zh: Aave 是一个链上借贷协议，其存款代币相当于计息收据，证明用户曾完成存款，并可赎回对应的底层资产——此次即为存入 Base 上 Aave 的 wstETH。wstETH 是 Lido 的封装质押 ETH，而 Base 是由 Coinbase 开发的以太坊二层网络。
threads.background_en: Aave is an onchain lending protocol where deposit tokens act as interest-bearing receipts proving a deposit was made, redeemable for the underlying asset — in this case wstETH deposited into Aave on Base. wstETH is Lido's wrapped staked ETH, and Base is a Coinbase-developed Ethereum layer-2 network.
threads.latest_summary_zh:
Base 网络上的一个金库在借款方白名单被修改后，通过六笔资金流出被抽走约 600 万美元的 Aave 存款代币。所得资金被兑换为 wstETH，其中一部分随后进入跨链桥提款流程，转向以太坊。

链上报道指出，问题并非源自智能合约漏洞，而是金库的借款方白名单被改动，其中一个恶意合约被加入——这凸显了访问控制配置是 Base 上 DeFi 金库用户面临的一类攻击面。

报道援引的链上数据显示，新部署的合约先被移出白名单，约一分钟后又被重新加入，随后未经授权的借款行为开始出现；六笔资金流出及后续跨链桥操作表明这是蓄意执行，而非意外配置错误。有报道称损失规模约为 1,783 枚 wstETH。
threads.latest_summary_en:
A vault on Base was drained of roughly $6 million in Aave deposit tokens through six outflows that followed a change to the vault's borrower whitelist. The proceeds were redeemed for wstETH, and some of those funds subsequently entered bridge withdrawals toward Ethereum.

On-chain reporting indicates the cause was not a smart contract bug but a change to the vault's borrower whitelist, where a malicious contract was added — highlighting access-control configuration as an attack surface for DeFi vault users on Base.

On-chain data cited in reports shows the newly deployed contract was removed from the whitelist and added back about one minute later, after which the unauthorized borrowing began; the six outflows and the later bridging suggest deliberate execution rather than accidental misconfiguration. One report put the amount lost at roughly 1,783 wstETH.
threads.market_impact_zh: 此次损失集中在一个持有 Aave 存款代币的 Base 金库，所得资金被换成 wstETH，其中一部分跨链桥转入以太坊，因此事件的影响路径主要涉及 wstETH 二级市场流动性和 Base 与以太坊之间的跨链桥资金流，而非协议层面的偿付能力问题。
threads.market_impact_en: The loss is concentrated in a single Base vault holding Aave deposit tokens, and the proceeds were converted into wstETH with part bridged toward Ethereum, linking the incident to wstETH secondary-market liquidity and Base–Ethereum bridge flows rather than to any protocol-wide solvency issue.

reference_links.title: Base vault drained of $6M in Aave deposit tokens after whitelist change

timeline.text_zh: 链上数据显示，攻击者先将新部署的合约移出金库借款方白名单，约一分钟后重新加入，随后发生六笔未经授权的资金流出；部分被盗资金经跨链桥转向以太坊。
timeline.text_en: On-chain data shows the attacker removed a newly deployed contract from the vault's borrower whitelist, added it back about one minute later, then executed six unauthorized outflows; some stolen funds were bridged toward Ethereum.

timeline.text_zh: GoPlus 披露攻击源于 Safe 多签将恶意合约加入借贷白名单，攻击者提取 1783 枚 aBaswstETH 并在 Aave V3 赎回约 1783 枚 wstETH，损失约 600 万美元；同时指出该金库内仍有约 3170 万美元资产处于风险中，团队在攻击前 25 天未执行 Safe 交易，可能遭社会工程学攻击或内部勾结。
timeline.text_en: GoPlus reports the attack stemmed from a Safe multisig whitelisting a malicious contract into the lending whitelist, with the attacker withdrawing 1,783 aBaswstETH and redeeming roughly 1,783 wstETH on Aave V3 for ~$6M in losses; it adds that ~$31.7M in assets remain at risk and that the team had not executed a Safe transaction for 25 days before the attack, possibly due to social engineering or insider collusion.

timeline.text_zh:
据 PeckShield 监测，Base 上一未命名金库遭攻击的损失已扩大至约 600 万美元，约合 1783 枚 wstETH。这一数字较此前 Blockaid 就该事件监测到的约 202 万美元有所上升。

据 Foresight News 此前援引 Blockaid 的消息，一个新合约被添加进该金库的白名单，攻击者从金库借出 aBaswstETH 并将 aTokens 发送至该合约，在约 4 笔交易中抽走约 202 万美元。PeckShield 最新给出的约 600 万美元（约 1783 枚 wstETH）显示损失规模已超过最初统计；该金库目前未被公开点名。
timeline.text_en: PeckShield reports that losses from an attack on an unnamed Base vault have grown to approximately $6 million, or about 1,783 wstETH, after an attacker contract was whitelisted and drained aBaswstETH/aTokens across a handful of transactions.

threads.title_zh: OpenAI 洽谈至少300亿美元融资，投前估值约1.4万亿美元
threads.title_en: OpenAI in talks for at least $30B funding at ~$1.4T pre-money valuation
threads.summary_zh: OpenAI 正与总部位于阿布扎比的 MGX 及其他阿联酋投资基金洽谈，由后者领投至少 300 亿美元的融资轮，贝莱德正讨论参与，投前估值固定约为 1.4 万亿美元，同时该公司推迟了 IPO。
threads.summary_en: OpenAI is in talks with Abu Dhabi-based MGX and other UAE investment funds to anchor a financing round of at least $30 billion, with BlackRock discussing participation and a fixed ~$1.4 trillion pre-money valuation, as the company defers its IPO.
threads.latest_update_zh: OpenAI 正与总部位于阿布扎比的 MGX 及其他阿联酋投资基金洽谈，由后者领投至少 300 亿美元的融资轮，贝莱德正讨论参与，投前估值固定约为 1.4 万亿美元，同时该公司推迟了 IPO。
threads.latest_update_en: OpenAI is in talks with Abu Dhabi-based MGX and other UAE investment funds to anchor a financing round of at least $30 billion, with BlackRock discussing participation and a fixed ~$1.4 trillion pre-money valuation, as the company defers its IPO.
threads.latest_summary_zh: OpenAI is in talks with Abu Dhabi-based MGX and other UAE investment funds to anchor a financing round of at least $30 billion, with BlackRock discussing participation and a fixed ~$1.4 trillion pre-money valuation, as the company defers its IPO.
threads.latest_summary_en: OpenAI is in talks with Abu Dhabi-based MGX and other UAE investment funds to anchor a financing round of at least $30 billion, with BlackRock discussing participation and a fixed ~$1.4 trillion pre-money valuation, as the company defers its IPO.
threads.market_impact_zh: OpenAI 的股权并不在加密市场直接交易，因此其影响主要通过情绪与资金流向传导至 AI 叙事相关资产，例如去中心化算力与 AI Agent 类代币；同时，如此规模的私募融资也会影响整体私募市场的流动性环境，进而关系到加密与 AI 创业项目可获得的冒险资本规模。
threads.market_impact_en: OpenAI equity is not directly tradable in crypto markets, so any transmission runs through sentiment and capital flows around AI-narrative assets — decentralized compute and AI-agent tokens — as well as broader private-market liquidity conditions that shape how much risk capital is available to crypto and AI ventures alike.

timeline.text_zh: OpenAI 正与总部位于阿布扎比的 MGX 及其他阿联酋投资基金洽谈，由后者领投至少 300 亿美元的融资轮，贝莱德正讨论参与，投前估值固定约为 1.4 万亿美元，同时该公司推迟了 IPO。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI is in talks with Abu Dhabi-based MGX and other UAE investment funds to anchor a financing round of at least $30 billion, with BlackRock discussing participation and a fixed ~$1.4 trillion pre-money valuation, as the company defers its IPO.

timeline.text_zh: OpenAI在将IPO推迟至2026年之后，正以约1.4万亿美元估值寻求至少300亿美元新融资，其年化收入已超过400亿美元；而Anthropic预计将于11月IPO，潜在估值超过2万亿美元。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI is seeking at least $30 billion in new funding at roughly a $1.4 trillion valuation after postponing its IPO beyond 2026, with annualized revenue surpassing $40 billion, while Anthropic is expected to IPO in November at a potential valuation above $2 trillion.

timeline.text_zh:
据 BlockBeats 援引彭博社 9 月 30 日的报道，OpenAI 计划以 1.4 万亿美元估值融资 300 亿美元。该报道描述的是一项融资计划，并未表明交易已经完成。

若按此规模完成，这将是史上规模最大的私募融资之一，所募资金将直接投入 OpenAI 的算力建设，并影响其与其他前沿 AI 实验室的竞争格局。

该数字来源于彭博社，时间标注为 9 月 30 日；报道所描述的核心要素是融资金额、估值，以及该融资目前仍属计划、而非已完成交易这一事实。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI is reportedly planning to raise $30 billion in funding at a $1.4 trillion valuation, according to Bloomberg.

threads.title_zh: Mistral AI 发布旗舰模型 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）
threads.title_en: Mistral AI Releases Flagship Model Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk)
threads.summary_zh: Mistral 已发布旗舰模型 Mistral Large 4（内部昵称 Le Chonk），采用 MoE 架构，总参数1.05万亿、激活490亿，支持多模态和100万token上下文；API已开放预览，权重计划10月27日公开，Mistral 称其为美欧最强开放权重模型并公布自测基准。
threads.summary_en: Mistral AI launched Mistral Large 4, a 1-trillion-parameter model activating 49 billion parameters per query at $1.36/$4.18 per million input/output tokens, which it says will become the strongest open-weight model yet with weights due by end of October.
threads.latest_update_zh: 补充发布细节：Mistral Large 4 为1.05万亿参数MoE模型，每次推理激活490亿参数，原生支持图文输入，上下文最长100万token；API已开放预览，模型权重计划10月27日公开，并给出自测基准成绩。
threads.latest_update_en: Added release details: Mistral Large 4 is a 1.05T-parameter MoE model activating 49B parameters per inference, natively supports image-text input, has up to 1M-token context; API preview is available, open weights are planned for October 27, and self-reported benchmark scores were provided.
threads.background_zh: Mistral 主打“主权 AI”，即一个国家或企业可以自行拥有和运行、无需将数据交给外部公司的模型；沙特国家支持的 HUMAIN 于 8 月与该公司签署了价值数亿欧元的协议。9 月，Mistral 完成由三星领投的 30 亿欧元（33.7 亿美元）D 轮融资，估值超过 210 亿欧元（236 亿美元），公司称 Large 4 是这笔资金所支持路线图上的第一个里程碑。“Le Chonk”这一昵称源自 6 月：在 Mistral 将其 Le Chat 助手更名为 Vibe 后，Reddit 和 X 上的粉丝虚构了一个名为 Le Chaton Fat 的模型；CEO Arthur Mensch 顺势回应，如今 Mistral 的发布帖将该模型“非常正式地”列为 le Chonk。
threads.background_en: Mistral markets "sovereign AI" — models a country or company can own and run without handing data to outside firms — and Saudi Arabia's state-backed HUMAIN signed a deal worth hundreds of millions of euros with the lab in August. In September Mistral raised a €3 billion ($3.37 billion) Series D led by Samsung at a valuation above €21 billion ($23.6 billion), and says Large 4 is the first milestone on the roadmap that money funds. The "Le Chonk" nickname traces back to June, when fans on Reddit and X invented a fictional model called Le Chaton Fat after Mistral renamed its Le Chat assistant to Vibe; CEO Arthur Mensch played along, and Mistral's launch post now lists the model as, "very officially," le Chonk.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Mistral released its flagship Mistral Large 4, a 1.05T-parameter MoE model activating 49B parameters per inference with multimodal input and 1M-token context, available now via API preview with open weights slated for October 27 and self-reported benchmarks claiming the strongest open-weights model from the US or Europe.
threads.latest_summary_en: Mistral released its flagship Mistral Large 4, a 1.05T-parameter MoE model activating 49B parameters per inference with multimodal input and 1M-token context, available now via API preview with open weights slated for October 27 and self-reported benchmarks claiming the strongest open-weights model from the US or Europe.
threads.discussion_zh: 评论者总体持正面看法，但更关注局限。Simon Willison 指出，该模型只支持 “none” 或 “high” 两档推理设置，且差异似乎不大，“high” 产生的输出 token 甚至少于 “none”。有评论者追问：一个在 Mistral 欧洲自有数据中心、约 3800 块 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPU 上训练的 1T 参数模型，性能接近 Kimi K3，这意味着什么；也有人称赞其视觉与网络安全基准表现。一位 Plotly 员工表示，该模型比 4 月的 Mistral Medium 3.5 便宜 10 倍，在其数据分析基准上从 58% 提升到 74%。
threads.discussion_en: Commenters were broadly positive but focused on caveats. Simon Willison noted that the model only supports reasoning settings of "none" or "high," and that the difference appeared minor, with "high" producing fewer output tokens than "none." One commenter questioned what it means that a 1T-parameter model trained on roughly 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral's European datacenters can approach Kimi K3's performance, while another praised its vision and cybersecurity benchmarks; a Plotly staffer said it was 10x cheaper than Mistral Medium 3.5 from April and improved from 58% to 74% on their data analytics benchmark.
threads.market_impact_zh: Mistral AI 为私人持股公司，没有发行代币，因此对加密市场的传导是间接的、由情绪驱动的：每百万 token 1.36 美元／4.18 美元的低价前沿推理拉高了竞争门槛，对去中心化算力与推理市场等 AI 相关加密叙事构成参照压力，因为这些项目争夺同样的开发者与企业预算。就现有证据而言，此次发布并不对应任何加密资产的直接敞口。
threads.market_impact_en: Mistral AI is privately held and has no token, so any read-through to crypto markets is indirect and sentiment-driven: cheaper frontier inference at $1.36/$4.18 per million tokens raises the competitive bar for AI-related crypto narratives such as decentralized compute and inference markets, which compete for the same developer and enterprise budgets. There is no direct exposure to the launch through any listed crypto asset on the evidence available.

threads.title_zh: EmbeddingGemma 2：一款开放、轻量的多模态嵌入模型
threads.title_en: EmbeddingGemma 2: An open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
threads.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 已开源 EmbeddingGemma 2，一个 Apache 2.0 许可的 740M 参数多模态嵌入模型，统一文本、代码、图片、视频和音频检索，支持端侧灵活加载与向量降维，并在代码检索等基准上较上代提升。
threads.summary_en: Google DeepMind has open-sourced EmbeddingGemma 2, an Apache 2.0-licensed 740M-parameter multimodal embedding model unifying text, code, image, video and audio retrieval, with flexible on-device loading and vector dimension reduction, improving code retrieval benchmarks over the prior generation.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新增技术细节：完整模型为 740M 参数，统一支持文本、代码、图片、视频和音频的向量检索；可按需加载，仅文本/代码为 270M，加视觉为 440M，全量为 740M；上下文由 2K 提升至 8K；MTEB Code 得分从 68.76 升至 78.68；支持将 768 维压缩至 512/256/128 维；Pixel 11 Pro 上量化后内存占用约 191MB/567MB。
threads.latest_update_en: Adds technical details: full model is 740M parameters unifying text, code, image, video and audio retrieval; supports flexible loading (270M text/code, 440M with vision, 740M full); context increased from 2K to 8K; MTEB Code score rose from 68.76 to 78.68; 768-dim vectors can be compressed to 512/256/128; quantized memory on Pixel 11 Pro about 191MB/567MB.
threads.background_zh: Google 此前发布了 EmbeddingGemma，这是一个专为端侧 AI 设计的 3.08 亿参数模型，使检索增强生成（RAG）和语义搜索等技术可以直接在本地硬件上运行。开放权重发布的是模型训练后的参数，而许可证决定模型能否被修改、微调或再分发。多模态嵌入模型则把来自多种模态的非结构化数据映射到同一个向量空间。
threads.background_en: Google previously released EmbeddingGemma, a 308-million-parameter model designed specifically for on-device AI, enabling techniques such as retrieval augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search to run directly on local hardware. Open-weights releases publish a model's learned parameters, while the license determines whether the model may be modified, fine-tuned or redistributed. Multimodal embedding models map unstructured data from more than one modality into a shared vector space.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Google DeepMind open-sourced EmbeddingGemma 2, a 740M-parameter multimodal embedding model that unifies text, code, image, video and audio search in one vector space, runs on-device with flexible parameter loading, and ships under Apache 2.0.
threads.latest_summary_en: Google DeepMind open-sourced EmbeddingGemma 2, a 740M-parameter multimodal embedding model that unifies text, code, image, video and audio search in one vector space, runs on-device with flexible parameter loading, and ships under Apache 2.0.
threads.discussion_zh: Hacker News 讨论帖获得约 184 分和 25 条评论，simonw、minimaxir 等从业者总体持正面态度，称赞其 Apache 2.0 许可证与多模态能力；minimaxir 表示此前一直没有好用的中等规模嵌入模型，令人困扰。最主要的保留意见是关于采用 MRL 而非 MatFormers 训练，导致无法随嵌入维度降低而同步压缩权重。
threads.discussion_en: The Hacker News thread drew roughly 184 points and 25 comments, with practitioners such as simonw and minimaxir broadly positive: the Apache 2.0 license and multimodal capability were praised, with minimaxir saying the lack of a good moderate-size embedding model had been an annoyance. The main caveat raised was the MRL-versus-MatFormers training choice, which prevents shrinking weights with lower-dimensional embeddings.

timeline.text_zh: 新增技术细节：完整模型为 740M 参数，统一支持文本、代码、图片、视频和音频的向量检索；可按需加载，仅文本/代码为 270M，加视觉为 440M，全量为 740M；上下文由 2K 提升至 8K；MTEB Code 得分从 68.76 升至 78.68；支持将 768 维压缩至 512/256/128 维；Pixel 11 Pro 上量化后内存占用约 191MB/567MB。
timeline.text_en: Adds technical details: full model is 740M parameters unifying text, code, image, video and audio retrieval; supports flexible loading (270M text/code, 440M with vision, 740M full); context increased from 2K to 8K; MTEB Code score rose from 68.76 to 78.68; 768-dim vectors can be compressed to 512/256/128; quantized memory on Pixel 11 Pro about 191MB/567MB.

timeline.text_zh:
Google 发布了 EmbeddingGemma 2，这是一个以 Apache 2.0 许可证开源的开放权重嵌入模型，提供 270M 纯文本版本和 440M 文本+视觉版本。该模型面向本地与端侧嵌入向量生成场景。

Hacker News 上的评论者认为该发布填补了缺少优质中等规模嵌入模型的空白；simonw 指出，嵌入模型尤其不应采用封闭且仅限托管的模式，因为应用会把向量长期存储用于后续比对，而厂商有朝一日可能停止提供该模型。

评论者 aabhay 指出，与此前的端侧嵌入模型不同，EmbeddingGemma 2 似乎是使用 MRL 而非 MatFormers 训练的，因此无法在降低嵌入维度的同时同步缩小模型权重。另一位评论者 Nautman 则提到它可通过 MediaPipe 用于文本与图像任务。
timeline.text_en: Google released EmbeddingGemma 2, an Apache 2.0-licensed lightweight multimodal embedding model for on-device and local use, prompting technical discussion about its license, MRL-based training and comparisons to rival embedding models.

threads.title_zh: 彭博终端接入 Hyperliquid 永续合约行情
threads.title_en: Bloomberg Terminal Adds Hyperliquid Perpetuals Pricing
threads.summary_zh: 彭博终端已通过WSL HYPE工作表新增全天候Hyperliquid永续合约报价，将永续合约与大宗商品、指数、股票、外汇和加密货币的参考价格并列显示。
threads.summary_en: Bloomberg Terminal has added around-the-clock Hyperliquid perpetual futures pricing via a WSL HYPE worksheet that pairs perps with reference prices across commodities, indexes, equities, currencies and crypto.
threads.latest_update_zh: 彭博终端已通过WSL HYPE工作表新增全天候Hyperliquid永续合约报价，将永续合约与大宗商品、指数、股票、外汇和加密货币的参考价格并列显示。
threads.latest_update_en: Bloomberg Terminal has added around-the-clock Hyperliquid perpetual futures pricing via a WSL HYPE worksheet that pairs perps with reference prices across commodities, indexes, equities, currencies and crypto.
threads.background_zh: Hyperliquid 是一个链上交易场所，提供 300 多个永续合约与现货市场，全天候运行且非托管。永续合约是没有到期日的合约，通过资金费率机制使合约价格与参考资产价格保持一致。
threads.background_en: Hyperliquid is an on-chain venue offering 300-plus perpetual and spot markets that run 24/7 and are non-custodial. Perpetual futures are contracts without an expiration date that use a funding-rate mechanism to keep the contract price aligned with the reference asset.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Bloomberg Terminal has added around-the-clock Hyperliquid perpetual futures pricing via a WSL HYPE worksheet that pairs perps with reference prices across commodities, indexes, equities, currencies and crypto.
threads.latest_summary_en: Bloomberg Terminal has added around-the-clock Hyperliquid perpetual futures pricing via a WSL HYPE worksheet that pairs perps with reference prices across commodities, indexes, equities, currencies and crypto.
threads.market_impact_zh: 这里的传导渠道是数据分发与情绪，而非资金流入：Hyperliquid 的永续合约价格如今与传统基准一同出现在机构终端中，可能提升专业用户对 Hyperliquid 市场及其 HYPE 代币的关注度。由于该行情为只读且不涉及交易执行，其本身并不会直接推动资金进入该平台。
threads.market_impact_en: The channel here is data distribution and sentiment rather than fund flow: Hyperliquid perpetual prices now sit alongside traditional benchmarks in an institutional terminal, which could increase attention on Hyperliquid markets and its HYPE token among professional users. Because the feed is read-only and involves no execution, it does not by itself move capital onto the venue.

timeline.text_zh: 彭博终端已通过WSL HYPE工作表新增全天候Hyperliquid永续合约报价，将永续合约与大宗商品、指数、股票、外汇和加密货币的参考价格并列显示。
timeline.text_en: Bloomberg Terminal has added around-the-clock Hyperliquid perpetual futures pricing via a WSL HYPE worksheet that pairs perps with reference prices across commodities, indexes, equities, currencies and crypto.

timeline.text_zh:
据 BlockBeats 与 Foresight News 报道，彭博终端（Bloomberg Terminal）现已支持用户全天候监测 Hyperliquid 上的部分永续合约，覆盖加密货币、股票、大宗商品、外汇和指数等多类资产。用户可通过输入代码 WSL HYPE 调取相关行情，但该整合暂不支持交易执行。

机构交易团队如今可以在原有工作流中，将 Hyperliquid 的价格与 BTC、英伟达、标普 500 指数、布伦特原油和欧元兑美元等传统市场基准进行比较。原文指出，这将提升 Hyperliquid 市场的曝光度和可信度，使其成为机构熟悉的价格来源之一。

该整合涉及的是行情数据，而非监管批准或交易准入；交易执行仍在彭博终端之外进行，相关报道称可实时查看超过 100 个合约的行情。
timeline.text_en: Bloomberg Terminal has begun supporting round-the-clock monitoring of selected Hyperliquid perpetual contracts across crypto, equities, commodities, FX and indices, without trading execution, expanding the venue's institutional data distribution.

threads.title_zh: Polymarket将就荷兰禁令提起诉讼
threads.title_en: Polymarket将就荷兰禁令提起诉讼
threads.summary_zh: Polymarket 已向海牙地区法院提起诉讼，要求撤销 Ksa 的荷兰禁令并恢复市场准入，主张其事件合约应由 AFM 而非 Ksa 监管；Ksa 已收取 42 万欧元罚款。
threads.summary_en: Polymarket has sued at The Hague District Court to annul Ksa's Dutch ban and restore market access, arguing its event contracts should be supervised by AFM rather than Ksa; Ksa has collected €420k in fines.
threads.latest_update_zh: Polymarket 已正式向海牙地区法院起诉，要求撤销荷兰禁令并恢复市场准入；Ksa 已因停服晚于期限收取 42 万欧元罚款。
threads.latest_update_en: Polymarket has formally filed suit at The Hague District Court seeking annulment of the Dutch ban and restoration of market access; Ksa has collected €420k in fines because service stopped after the deadline.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Polymarket has sued at The Hague District Court to annul the Dutch gambling regulator's ban, arguing its event contracts are financial products that should be supervised by the financial markets authority rather than classified as unlicensed gambling that already drew €420k in fines.
threads.latest_summary_en: Polymarket has sued at The Hague District Court to annul the Dutch gambling regulator's ban, arguing its event contracts are financial products that should be supervised by the financial markets authority rather than classified as unlicensed gambling that already drew €420k in fines.

timeline.text_zh: Polymarket 已正式向海牙地区法院起诉，要求撤销荷兰禁令并恢复市场准入；Ksa 已因停服晚于期限收取 42 万欧元罚款。
timeline.text_en: Polymarket has formally filed suit at The Hague District Court seeking annulment of the Dutch ban and restoration of market access; Ksa has collected €420k in fines because service stopped after the deadline.

timeline.text_zh: Polymarket正就荷兰监管机构Ksa禁止其在荷兰运营的命令提起诉讼，主张其产品应由金融市场管理局AFM监管。
timeline.text_en: Polymarket is filing a lawsuit against the Dutch regulator Ksa's order barring it from operating in the Netherlands, arguing its product should instead be supervised by financial markets authority AFM.

threads.title_zh: Drift 基金会启动 DFX 索赔与赎回并披露恢复池覆盖有限
threads.title_en: Drift Foundation上线DFX索赔与赎回，每损失1 USDT可领1 DFX
threads.summary_zh: Drift基金会披露，其DFX补偿代币并非锚定1 USDT，当前恢复池仅覆盖约1%的总索赔，而Tether已承诺提供最高1.275亿USDT，与Velocity净协议收入挂钩，用于支持重启和用户偿还，索赔截止日期为2028年1月1日。
threads.summary_en: The Drift Foundation disclosed that its DFX compensation token is not pegged to 1 USDT and that the current recovery pool covers only about 1% of total claims, while Tether has committed up to 127.5M USDT tied to Velocity net protocol revenue to support the restart and user repayment, with claims due by January 1, 2028.
threads.latest_update_zh: Drift基金会披露，其DFX补偿代币并非锚定1 USDT，当前恢复池仅覆盖约1%的总索赔，而Tether已承诺提供最高1.275亿USDT，与Velocity净协议收入挂钩，用于支持重启和用户偿还，索赔截止日期为2028年1月1日。
threads.latest_update_en: The Drift Foundation disclosed that its DFX compensation token is not pegged to 1 USDT and that the current recovery pool covers only about 1% of total claims, while Tether has committed up to 127.5M USDT tied to Velocity net protocol revenue to support the restart and user repayment, with claims due by January 1, 2028.
threads.background_zh: DFX 是 Solana 上的标准 SPL 代币，用于赔偿 Drift 协议在 4 月事件中已核实的 USDT 损失。USDT 发行方 Tether 是稳定币领域主要的协议收入来源之一，这构成了其支持与 Velocity 净协议收入挂钩安排的基础。
threads.background_en: DFX is a standard SPL token on Solana issued to compensate verified USDT losses from the April incident affecting the Drift protocol. Tether, the issuer of USDT, is a major source of protocol revenue in the stablecoin sector, which underpins the arrangement linking its support to Velocity's net protocol revenue.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The Drift Foundation disclosed that its DFX compensation token is not pegged to 1 USDT and that the current recovery pool covers only about 1% of total claims, while Tether has committed up to 127.5M USDT tied to Velocity net protocol revenue to support the restart and user repayment, with claims due by January 1, 2028.
threads.latest_summary_en: The Drift Foundation disclosed that its DFX compensation token is not pegged to 1 USDT and that the current recovery pool covers only about 1% of total claims, while Tether has committed up to 127.5M USDT tied to Velocity net protocol revenue to support the restart and user repayment, with claims due by January 1, 2028.
threads.market_impact_zh: 这一条款影响 DFX 持有者及在 Solana 上蒙受已核实损失的用户：DFX 可在 Raydium 交易，且赎回按恢复池余额计算，因此二级市场价格可能与名义 1 USDT 索赔额出现偏离。Tether 的支持与 Velocity 净协议收入挂钩，使偿还进度取决于该收入流而非前置的 USDT 注入，这会影响市场对稳定币发行方支持 DeFi 恢复案例的情绪。
threads.market_impact_en: The terms affect holders of DFX and users with verified losses on Solana, since DFX's tradable status on Raydium and the pool-based redemption formula create a secondary market whose price can diverge from the nominal 1 USDT claim. Tether's commitment tied to Velocity net protocol revenue links the pace of repayment to that revenue stream rather than to an upfront USDT injection, which bears on sentiment around stablecoin-issuer-backed DeFi recoveries.

DFX Token Redemption: Claim Window Closes Jan 1, 2028 ...

timeline.text_zh: Drift基金会披露，其DFX补偿代币并非锚定1 USDT，当前恢复池仅覆盖约1%的总索赔，而Tether已承诺提供最高1.275亿USDT，与Velocity净协议收入挂钩，用于支持重启和用户偿还，索赔截止日期为2028年1月1日。
timeline.text_en: The Drift Foundation disclosed that its DFX compensation token is not pegged to 1 USDT and that the current recovery pool covers only about 1% of total claims, while Tether has committed up to 127.5M USDT tied to Velocity net protocol revenue to support the restart and user repayment, with claims due by January 1, 2028.

timeline.text_zh: 社区对DFX赎回定价反应强烈：按约311万USDT追偿池与约2.995亿枚DFX计算，赎回价约0.0104美元，即每100美元损失目前仅可兑回约1美元（约1%回收率）。同时DFX二级市场价格从约0.01美元升至约0.03美元，24小时涨幅约210%，但流动性仅约20万美元；上涨反映对未来追偿资金到账及销毁机制的预期，而非池内余额已增加。
timeline.text_en: Community backlash emerged over DFX redemption pricing: with a ~$3.11M recovery pool against ~299.5M DFX, the redemption price is ~$0.0104, meaning roughly $1 recovered per $100 of loss (~1% recovery). Meanwhile DFX secondary-market price rose from ~$0.01 to ~$0.03, up ~210% in 24 hours, on only ~$200K liquidity; the move reflects expectations of future recoveries and burn mechanics, not an increase in the pool balance.

timeline.text_zh:
10月2日，Drift Foundation宣布DFX索赔与赎回已上线，在4月1日事件中经验证存在损失的用户可按每损失1 USDT领取1 DFX。每枚DFX对应Recovery Pool的索赔权，该池目前约有311万USDT。

此举把4月1日事件中的损失转化为一种由资金池支撑的索赔权结构，让经验证的受害者有了明确的赎回路径，而非无限期的追偿承诺。相对于全部损失规模，池内资金规模意味着每枚DFX的赎回金额取决于后续追回与承诺资金的到位情况。

DFX可按「Recovery Pool余额 ÷ DFX未偿供应量」计算的Redemption Amount兑换USDT，赎回后的DFX将被销毁且交易不可撤销。Recovery Pool的资金来源包括Velocity每日部分协议净收入、Tether最高1.275亿USDT的配套资金、战略合作伙伴最高2,000万USDT，以及后续追回的资产；索赔窗口将于2028年1月1日00:00 UTC关闭，届时未领取的DFX将被销毁。
timeline.text_en: Drift Foundation launched DFX claims and redemption for verified victims of the April 1 exploit (~$295.4M stolen), granting 1 DFX per 1 USDT of loss redeemable against a Recovery Pool of ~3.11M USDT backed by up to $127.5M in Tether matching funds and up to $20M from strategic partners, with claims closing 2028-01-01 UTC.

threads.title_zh: Reflection 推出 Beam：一款以更低算力成本对标中国模型的开源权重 AI 模型
threads.title_en: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
threads.summary_zh: Reflection AI 于 2026 年 10 月 5 日发布其首个前沿开源权重模型 Beam，这是一个总参数 5010 亿、激活参数 230 亿的稀疏 MoE 模型，面向编程、推理和智能体任务。新报道显示，Reflection 自行公布的基准测试中 Beam 在 DeepSWE 上得分 44.4，接近 GLM-5.2 但落后于最新的中国头部开源模型。Beam 仍在最后安全测试阶段，仅少量用户可提前使用；完整权重、技术报告和模型卡计划 2026 年 10 月晚些时候以 Apache 2.0 协议发布。训练使用 6144 块 GB300 预训练不到 4 周处理 23.8 万亿 token，再用 1.05 万块 GB300 进行 4 周强化学习，生成超过 1 亿条训练轨迹。
threads.summary_en: Reflection AI unveiled Beam on October 5, 2026, its first frontier open-weight sparse MoE model with 501B total and 23B active parameters for coding, reasoning and agentic tasks. New coverage shows Reflection's own benchmarks place Beam at 44.4 on DeepSWE, close to GLM-5.2 but behind the newest Chinese open-weight models. Beam is still in final safety testing with limited early access; full weights, technical report and model card are planned for later in October 2026 under Apache 2.0. Training used 6,144 GB300 GPUs for pretraining under 4 weeks on 23.8 trillion tokens, followed by 4 weeks of reinforcement learning on 10,500 GB300 GPUs generating over 100 million rollouts.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充了 Reflection 自行公布的基准测试结果，显示 Beam 在 DeepSWE 上得分 44.4，接近 GLM-5.2（44.0），但落后于 Qwen 3.8-Max、GLM-5.3、Kimi K3 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash。训练方面，预训练使用 6144 块 GB300，不到 4 周处理 23.8 万亿 token；随后用 1.05 万块 GB300 进行 4 周强化学习，生成超过 1 亿条训练轨迹。Beam 仍在最后安全测试阶段，仅少量用户可提前使用；完整权重、技术报告和模型卡计划本月晚些时候以 Apache 2.0 协议发布。
threads.latest_update_en: New coverage adds Reflection's own benchmark results showing Beam scoring 44.4 on DeepSWE, close to GLM-5.2's 44.0 but behind Qwen 3.8-Max, GLM-5.3, Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Training details: pretraining on 6,144 GB300 GPUs processing 23.8 trillion tokens in under 4 weeks, followed by 4 weeks of reinforcement learning on 10,500 GB300 GPUs generating over 100 million rollouts. Beam is still in final safety testing with limited early access; full weights, technical report and model card are planned for later this month under Apache 2.0.
threads.background_zh: 开源权重指已训练 AI 模型公开释放的学习参数，是否允许修改、微调或再分发取决于具体许可证。DeepSeek、阿里云、月之暗面（Moonshot AI）和 Z.ai 等中国企业普遍以 Apache 或 MIT 等宽松许可发布开源权重模型，而美国大型实验室更倾向于闭源发布。截至 2026 年 7 月，规模最大的开源权重前沿模型是月之暗面的 Kimi K3（2.8 万亿参数）和阿里云的 Qwen3.8（2.4 万亿参数）。
threads.background_en: Open weights are the publicly released learned parameters of a trained AI model; permission to modify, fine-tune or redistribute them depends on the license. Chinese companies including DeepSeek, Alibaba Cloud, Moonshot AI and Z.ai have generally released open-weight models under permissive licenses such as Apache or MIT, while large US labs have favored proprietary releases. As of July 2026, the largest open-weight frontier models were Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 at 2.8 trillion parameters and Alibaba Cloud's Qwen3.8 at 2.4 trillion.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Nvidia-backed Reflection announced Beam, a 501B-parameter MoE open-weights model (23B active) for code, reasoning and agent tasks trained on thousands of GB300 GPUs, though its own benchmarks place it behind the newest Chinese open-source models and full weights are only due later this month under Apache 2.0.
threads.latest_summary_en: Nvidia-backed Reflection announced Beam, a 501B-parameter MoE open-weights model (23B active) for code, reasoning and agent tasks trained on thousands of GB300 GPUs, though its own benchmarks place it behind the newest Chinese open-source models and full weights are only due later this month under Apache 2.0.
threads.market_impact_zh: 开源权重模型的发布会把部分模型部署转向自托管和本地司法辖区内的“AI 工厂”模式，这一渠道影响的是 GPU 与基础设施需求、推理托管和 API 定价，而非直接作用于交易市场。Reflection 获得英伟达投资，并以主权国家与企业为销售对象，因此与基础设施和算力需求这一议题相关联。
threads.market_impact_en: Open-weight releases shift part of model deployment toward self-hosting and in-jurisdiction "AI factory" setups, a channel that touches GPU and infrastructure demand, inference hosting and API pricing rather than trading directly. Reflection's Nvidia backing and its sovereign-enterprise go-to-market place it in that infrastructure and compute-demand discussion.

timeline.text_en: New coverage adds Reflection's own benchmark results showing Beam scoring 44.4 on DeepSWE, close to GLM-5.2's 44.0 but behind Qwen 3.8-Max, GLM-5.3, Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.
