timeline.text_zh:
2026 年 10 月 5 日（周一），Reflection AI 发布了其首个前沿开源权重模型 Beam。据该公司博客介绍，Beam 是一个稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型，总参数 5010 亿、激活参数 230 亿，面向编程、推理与智能体（agentic）任务。

此次发布使一家美国实验室在编程及相关任务上，直接与 DeepSeek、月之暗面 Kimi 等低成本中国开源权重模型展开竞争，而这一领域此前由中国模型的成本水平树立标杆。

Reflection 由英伟达（Nvidia）投资，并以“AI 工厂”（AI factories）产品向企业和主权国家推销 Beam 及后续模型，允许机构用自有专有数据训练这些模型。目前公开报道中未包含独立的基准测试结果或授权条款。
timeline.text_en:
Reflection AI unveiled Beam on Monday, October 5, 2026, its first frontier open-weight model. According to the company's blog, Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 501 billion total parameters and 23 billion active, built for coding, reasoning and agentic workloads.

The launch puts a US lab in direct competition with lower-cost Chinese open-weight models such as DeepSeek and Moonshot AI's Kimi in coding and related tasks, a segment where Chinese releases have set the cost benchmark.

Reflection is Nvidia-backed and is pitching Beam and future models at enterprises and sovereign nations through an "AI factories" offering that would let institutions train the models on their own proprietary data. The available coverage does not include independent benchmark results or licensing terms.

threads.title_zh: Aptos推出MonoMove，面向链上市场的引擎速度提升55倍
threads.title_en: Aptos推出MonoMove，面向链上市场的引擎速度提升55倍
threads.summary_zh: Aptos Labs 提出的 MonoMove 执行引擎升级公布更多测试数据，称部分智能合约负载最高提速55倍、顺序吞吐量最高提升11倍；仍需治理批准，预计2026年底功能完备，2027年主网上线。
threads.summary_en: Aptos Labs' proposed MonoMove execution-engine upgrade has additional test data: up to 55x faster on some smart contract workloads and up to 11x higher sequential throughput, subject to governance approval, with feature completeness expected by end of 2026 and mainnet rollout planned for 2027.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新增信息：内部测试显示端到端顺序吞吐量最高提升11倍；该升级需治理批准，预计2026年底功能完备，2027年主网上线。
threads.latest_update_en: Adds that internal tests show up to 11x higher end-to-end sequential throughput; the upgrade requires governance approval, with feature completeness expected by end of 2026 and mainnet rollout planned for 2027.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Aptos Labs proposed MonoMove, an execution-engine upgrade it says runs some smart contract workloads up to 55x faster and boosts sequential throughput up to 11x in internal tests, with governance approval needed ahead of a 2027 mainnet rollout.
threads.latest_summary_en: Aptos Labs proposed MonoMove, an execution-engine upgrade it says runs some smart contract workloads up to 55x faster and boosts sequential throughput up to 11x in internal tests, with governance approval needed ahead of a 2027 mainnet rollout.

timeline.text_zh: 新增信息：内部测试显示端到端顺序吞吐量最高提升11倍；该升级需治理批准，预计2026年底功能完备，2027年主网上线。
timeline.text_en: Adds that internal tests show up to 11x higher end-to-end sequential throughput; the upgrade requires governance approval, with feature completeness expected by end of 2026 and mainnet rollout planned for 2027.

timeline.text_zh: Aptos Labs发布MonoMove，这是一项拟议的执行引擎改造，称可将智能合约运行速度提升至多55倍，并声称在其全链上交易平台Decibel上，抵押品提取速度可提升至多55倍，下单速度提升22倍。

threads.title_zh: Strategy斥资9.508亿美元回购STRC，远超同期比特币买入
threads.title_en: Strategy prioritizes $950 million STRC buyback over expanding its Bitcoin treasury
threads.summary_zh: Strategy持续将资本配置优先用于STRC回购而非增持比特币：截至2026年10月5日当周，其买入334枚BTC（2870万美元），并回购约177万股STRC（1.763亿美元），比特币持仓达848,000枚。Q3比特币净增仅1,666枚，同期STRC回购支出约13.8亿美元。公司正寻求股东批准将STRC、STRF、STRK和STRD的股息改为每日支付，投票定于10月28日；STRC交易价约99.45美元，仍低于100美元目标价。
threads.summary_en: Strategy continues to prioritize STRC buybacks over Bitcoin accumulation: in the week ended Oct. 5, 2026, it bought 334 BTC for $28.7 million while repurchasing about 1.77 million STRC shares for $176.3 million, bringing BTC holdings to 848,000. Q3 net BTC increase was only 1,666 BTC, while STRC repurchases totaled about $1.38 billion. It is seeking shareholder approval to move STRC, STRF, STRK and STRD to daily dividend payments, with a vote on Oct. 28; STRC trades near $99.45, still below its $100 target.
threads.latest_update_zh: 2026年9月29日至10月5日当周，Strategy买入334枚BTC（花费2870万美元），同时以1.763亿美元回购约177万股STRC；比特币持仓增至848,000枚。此外，公司提交代理文件寻求股东批准将STRC、STRF、STRK和STRD的股息支付改为每个工作日支付，特别股东大会定于10月28日。Q3比特币持仓仅净增1,666枚，因当季买入7,218枚并卖出5,553枚；Q3回购STRC支出约13.8亿美元。
threads.latest_update_en: During the week of Sept 29–Oct 5, Strategy bought 334 BTC for $28.7 million while repurchasing about 1.77 million STRC shares for $176.3 million; BTC holdings reached 848,000. It also filed a proxy seeking shareholder approval to move STRC, STRF, STRK and STRD to daily dividend payments, with a special meeting set for Oct. 28. Q3 BTC holdings rose only 1,666 BTC net as it bought 7,218 and sold 5,553; Q3 STRC repurchases totaled about $1.38 billion.
threads.background_zh: Strategy（原 MicroStrategy）是最大的企业比特币持有者，通过股票、可转换债券和优先证券为其储备策略融资。STRC 是其可变利率 A 系列永久拉伸优先股（Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock），是公司配合普通股发行所使用的多类优先股之一。8-K 表格是 SEC 要求用于及时披露重大公司事件的当前报告。
threads.background_en: Strategy, formerly MicroStrategy, is the largest corporate holder of Bitcoin and funds its treasury strategy through equity, convertible debt and preferred securities. STRC is its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock, one of several preferred classes the company has used alongside common-stock issuance. Form 8-K is the SEC current report used to disclose material corporate events promptly.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Strategy bought 334 BTC for $28.7 million last week while spending $176.3 million to repurchase about 1.77 million STRC preferred shares and seeking shareholder approval to overhaul preferred-stock dividend payments.
threads.latest_summary_en: Strategy bought 334 BTC for $28.7 million last week while spending $176.3 million to repurchase about 1.77 million STRC preferred shares and seeking shareholder approval to overhaul preferred-stock dividend payments.
threads.market_impact_zh: 该披露将关注点转向最大的企业比特币储备如何为自身融资：大规模 STRC 回购和拟议的每日派息安排，直接影响 Strategy 优先证券的流动性与价格稳定性，并间接影响市场对企业储备式比特币需求的情绪。MSTR 与 STRC 是直接受影响的上市工具，其影响可能外溢至更广泛的企业比特币持有者板块，而非比特币现货市场结构本身。
threads.market_impact_en: The disclosure shifts attention to how the largest corporate Bitcoin treasury funds itself: heavy STRC buybacks and a proposed daily dividend schedule bear on the liquidity and price stability of Strategy's preferred securities and, indirectly, on sentiment toward corporate-treasury Bitcoin demand. MSTR and STRC are the directly affected listed instruments, with knock-on effects possible for the broader corporate-Bitcoin-holder segment rather than for Bitcoin's spot market structure.

Q3 BTC holdings rose only 1,666 BTC net as it bought 7,218 and sold 5,553; Q3 STRC repurchases totaled about $1.38 billion.

timeline.text_zh: 最新披露显示，Strategy累计回购STRC的支出已增至约12.8亿美元，占20亿美元回购授权额度的64%，剩余不足7.24亿美元；累计回购约1330万股STRC，约占流通股的八分之一。上周回购支出1.517亿美元，回购均价升至98.86美元，远高于7月底约86.52美元的均价。
timeline.text_en: Latest disclosure shows Strategy has spent about $1.28 billion, or 64%, of its $2 billion STRC repurchase authorization, leaving less than $724 million; it has repurchased 13.3 million STRC shares, roughly one in eight outstanding. Last week it spent $151.7 million at an average price of $98.86, up from an average of $86.52 in late July.

timeline.text_zh:
Strategy在7月20日至9月13日的八个报告期内，累计回购约996万股STRC可变利率优先股，耗资约9.508亿美元；其中9月14日文件披露，公司在9月8日至13日回购了1,420,467股STRC，金额1.393亿美元。同一时段内，其唯一披露的比特币买入是8月24日至30日购得的4,603枚BTC、耗资3.697亿美元，即STRC回购支出约为同期比特币买入的2.57倍。

Strategy是持有比特币最多的上市公司，其把可自由支配的现金用于回购自家优先股而非继续增持比特币，是一个重要的资本配置信号，直接影响市场对企业级比特币金库需求增长节奏的判断。这也把投资者注意力引向支撑其比特币持仓的融资结构——优先股股息及其偿付储备，对MSTR股票和STRC优先股持有人都同样重要。

本次回购全部来自Strategy可灵活支配的USD Cash余额，截至9月13日该余额为13亿美元；另有一笔51亿美元的USD Reserve专门用于支付优先股股息和债务利息，且根据7月27日的政策，该储备未被授权用于STRC回购。公司在9月8日至13日报告期内既未买入也未卖出比特币，也未通过at-the-market（ATM）计划出售股份，截至9月13日仍持有845,050枚BTC；董事会已于9月8日将优先证券回购授权额度翻倍至20亿美元，尚余约10亿美元可用。
timeline.text_en: Strategy has spent roughly $950.8 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares since July 20, more than twice its Bitcoin purchases over the same period, while keeping about $1 billion authorized for further buybacks.

threads.title_zh: OCC 批准加密信托银行牌照并遭 ICBA 起诉
threads.title_en: OCC Approves Crypto Trust Bank Charters and Is Sued by ICBA
threads.summary_zh: 美国独立社区银行家协会起诉美国货币监理署，要求推翻其全国性信托银行规则和第 1176 号解释函，挑战 13 家与加密相关的信托银行所依赖的联邦牌照路径，使稳定币、支付和托管计划面临重组或延迟的风险。
threads.summary_en: The Independent Community Bankers of America sued the OCC to overturn its national trust bank rule and Interpretive Letter 1176, challenging the federal charter pathway relied on by 13 crypto-linked trust banks and putting stablecoin, payments, and custody plans at risk of restructuring or delay.
threads.latest_update_zh: 美国独立社区银行家协会起诉美国货币监理署，要求推翻其全国性信托银行规则和第 1176 号解释函，挑战 13 家与加密相关的信托银行所依赖的联邦牌照路径，使稳定币、支付和托管计划面临重组或延迟的风险。
threads.latest_update_en: The Independent Community Bankers of America sued the OCC to overturn its national trust bank rule and Interpretive Letter 1176, challenging the federal charter pathway relied on by 13 crypto-linked trust banks and putting stablecoin, payments, and custody plans at risk of restructuring or delay.
threads.background_zh: 国家信托银行牌照是 OCC 授予的联邦银行牌照，允许开展受托与托管业务，但不允许吸收存款或发放贷款；它长期服务于企业受托机构，而自 2025 年起成为加密行业进入美国银行体系的首选路径。OCC 于 2025 年 5 月明确银行可从事加密资产托管与执行服务，2025 年 7 月 OCC、美联储与 FDIC 又联合发布了关于银行机构加密资产保管的声明。Bastion 曾在 2025 年 9 月完成由 Coinbase Ventures 领投的 1460 万美元融资，索尼、三星旗下投资子公司、Andreessen Horowitz 的加密部门以及 Hashed 参投。
threads.background_en: A national trust bank charter is a federal banking license granted by the OCC that permits fiduciary and custody activities but not deposit-taking or lending; for decades it served corporate trustees, and since 2025 it has become the crypto industry's preferred entry point into the US banking system. The OCC clarified in May 2025 that banks may engage in crypto-asset custody and execution services, and in July 2025 the OCC, the Federal Reserve and the FDIC jointly issued a statement on crypto-asset safekeeping by banking organizations. Bastion had raised $14.6 million in a September 2025 round led by Coinbase Ventures, with participation from Sony, Samsung's investment subsidiary, Andreessen Horowitz's crypto arm and Hashed.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The Independent Community Bankers of America sued the OCC to overturn its national trust bank rule and Interpretive Letter 1176, challenging the federal charter pathway relied on by 13 crypto-linked trust banks and putting stablecoin, payments, and custody plans at risk of restructuring or delay.
threads.latest_summary_en: The Independent Community Bankers of America sued the OCC to overturn its national trust bank rule and Interpretive Letter 1176, challenging the federal charter pathway relied on by 13 crypto-linked trust banks and putting stablecoin, payments, and custody plans at risk of restructuring or delay.
threads.market_impact_zh: 该牌照把机构稳定币托管与发行需求导入联邦监管实体，可能推动托管与白标发行业务流向受 OCC 监管的场所，并强化联邦牌照机构相对州牌照竞争者的合规优势。它也扩大了稳定币发行方与机构配置方可选的受监管交易对手范围，但禁止吸储与放贷的限制决定了这种资产负债表效应能够延伸的范围。
threads.market_impact_en: The charter routes institutional stablecoin custody and issuance demand into a federally supervised entity, which can pull custody and white-label issuance flows toward OCC-regulated venues and reinforce the compliance advantage of federally chartered players over state-licensed competitors. It also widens the set of regulated counterparties available to stablecoin issuers and institutional allocators, though the prohibition on deposits and lending caps how far that balance-sheet effect can extend.

threads.title_zh: Compound DAO 提案 582 投票前储备资金购买 COMP 引发授权争议，随后提案 612 拟扩大治理对国库操作的延迟与取消权
threads.title_en: Compound DAO used protocol reserves to buy $52 million worth of COMP, and delegates call it a mandate breach
threads.summary_zh:
Compound DAO 正在就第 612 号提案进行投票，该提案拟将国库操作的延迟从两天延长至十天，并赋予治理机制取消待执行国库操作的权力。一个与 Humpy 相关联的钱包已投出 175 万枚 COMP 的支持票。

若获通过，该提案将延长治理机制对国库待执行操作作出反应的时间窗口，并新增一项取消权。而来自与 Humpy 相关联钱包的 175 万枚 COMP 支持票——Compound 社区此前曾指控该持有者策划治理攻击——使这一新权力直接面临集中度方面的担忧。

投票仍在进行中，因此尚未确认是否通过。该提案同时涉及更长的执行延迟和由治理控制的待执行国库操作取消权。
threads.summary_en:
Compound DAO is voting on Proposal 612, which would extend the delay on treasury operations from two days to ten and grant governance the power to cancel pending treasury actions. A wallet linked to Humpy has cast 1.75 million COMP votes in support of the proposal.

If approved, the proposal would lengthen the window in which governance can react to pending treasury actions and add a new cancellation power. The 1.75 million COMP votes backing it from a wallet tied to Humpy — a holder the Compound community has previously accused of engineering a governance attack — place concentration concerns directly on that new power.

The vote is still in progress, so passage is not confirmed. The measure covers both the longer execution delay and governance-controlled cancellation of pending treasury operations.

threads.market_impact_en: The change affects Compound's own governance and the treasury assets held in its timelock, and therefore COMP holders and DAO participants; a longer execution delay alters how quickly treasury funds can be moved, while concerns about voting-power concentration can weigh on sentiment toward COMP and set a precedent for treasury-security design at other DAOs.

timeline.text_zh:

若获通过，该提案将延长治理机制对国库待执行操作作出反应的时间窗口，并新增一项取消权。而来自与 Humpy 相关联钱包的 175 万枚 COMP 支持票——Compound 社区此前曾指控该持有者策划治理攻击——使这一新权力直接面临集中度方面的担忧。

投票仍在进行中，因此尚未确认是否通过。该提案同时涉及更长的执行延迟和由治理控制的待执行国库操作取消权。
timeline.text_en:
Compound DAO is voting on Proposal 612, which would extend the delay on treasury operations from two days to ten and grant governance the power to cancel pending treasury actions. A wallet linked to Humpy has cast 1.75 million COMP votes in support of the proposal.

If approved, the proposal would lengthen the window in which governance can react to pending treasury actions and add a new cancellation power. The 1.75 million COMP votes backing it from a wallet tied to Humpy — a holder the Compound community has previously accused of engineering a governance attack — place concentration concerns directly on that new power.

The vote is still in progress, so passage is not confirmed. The measure covers both the longer execution delay and governance-controlled cancellation of pending treasury operations.

threads.title_en: Inaugurating The Era Of Super Intelligence
threads.summary_zh: 杰伊·克莱顿已被特朗普正式任命领导新的“超级智能部队”，负责协调联邦政府确保美国在超级智能领域保持领先；该部队向总统及幕僚长苏西·怀尔斯汇报，克莱顿预计继续担任国家情报总监，弗格森、库珀和迈克尔一同参与。
threads.summary_en: Jay Clayton has been formally named by Trump to lead the new 'Super Intelligence Force,' tasked with coordinating federal efforts to keep America leading in superintelligence; the force reports to the president and Chief of Staff Susie Wiles, Clayton is expected to remain director of national intelligence, and Ferguson, Kupor and Michael are joining.
threads.latest_update_zh: 特朗普在Truth Social正式宣布任命国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿领导新的“超级智能部队”（Super Intelligence Force），将其此前被报道为预期的AI沙皇任命落实为正式公告；安德鲁·弗格森、斯科特·库珀和埃米尔·迈克尔也将加入。
threads.latest_update_en: Trump formally announced on Truth Social that Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton will lead a new federal 'Super Intelligence Force,' confirming the previously reported expected AI czar appointment; Andrew Ferguson, Scott Kupor and Emil Michael will also join.
threads.background_zh: 超级智能（superintelligence）通常指在整体智能或某一特定指标上超越人类的假想实体或软件系统。该命令出台前，白宫已推进多项人工智能政策行动，包括 2025 年 12 月一项旨在限制与之冲突的各州人工智能法律的国家人工智能政策框架总统行动，以及 2026 年 3 月发布的《人工智能国家政策框架》，其立法建议呼吁建立统一的联邦框架以优先于与之冲突的各州人工智能法规。
threads.background_en: Superintelligence generally denotes a hypothetical entity or software system whose intelligence surpasses humans overall or in a particular measure. The order follows earlier White House AI policy actions, including a December 2025 presidential action on a national AI policy framework aimed at limiting conflicting state AI laws, and a March 2026 National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence whose legislative recommendations call for a uniform federal framework that preempts conflicting state AI rules.
threads.latest_summary_zh: President Trump named US Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton to lead a new federal 'Super Intelligence Force' tasked with coordinating government efforts to keep America leading in superintelligence, with FTC chair Andrew Ferguson and other officials joining.
threads.latest_summary_en: President Trump named US Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton to lead a new federal 'Super Intelligence Force' tasked with coordinating government efforts to keep America leading in superintelligence, with FTC chair Andrew Ferguson and other officials joining.
threads.market_impact_zh: 传导路径主要经由监管与市场情绪：一份针对前沿人工智能的总统命令可能改变美国人工智能开发者的合规预期，并进而影响投资者对与人工智能及算力相关的加密代币所适用的政策预期。具体的市场影响取决于执行性条款，而这些条款并未出现在已公布的文本中。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through regulation and sentiment: a presidential order aimed at frontier AI can shift compliance expectations for US AI developers and, by extension, the policy backdrop that investors apply to AI- and compute-linked crypto tokens. Concrete market effects depend on the operative provisions, which are not visible in the released excerpt.

timeline.text_en: Trump formally announced on Truth Social that Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton will lead a new federal 'Super Intelligence Force,' confirming the previously reported expected AI czar appointment; Andrew Ferguson, Scott Kupor and Emil Michael will also join.

timeline.text_zh: 据CNN等多家媒体援引匿名消息人士报道，特朗普预计将任命美国国家情报总监Jay Clayton为他的新任AI事务负责人，该职位将在轻监管、行业自律的框架下负责监督AI创新与发展。
timeline.text_en: Trump is expected to name US director of national intelligence Jay Clayton as his new AI czar, a role that would oversee AI innovation and development under a light-regulation, industry self-policing framework, according to CNN and other media reports citing unnamed sources.

timeline.text_zh:
白宫在“总统行动”页面发布了一份名为《开启超级智能时代》（Inaugurating The Era Of Super Intelligence）的总统行政命令，标注日期为 2026 年 9 月。目前公布的文本仅包含第 1 条“目的”，其中称美国“正处于一场新的智能技术革命的前沿”，并指出现代人工智能领域诞生于美国。

作为总统依据宪法和法定授权签署的行政命令，它无需国会批准即可直接确立联邦政策方向。该命令将人工智能发展置于“超级智能”时代的框架之下，使前沿人工智能成为其所述政策目标的核心。

公布的文本仅包含惯例性的授权条款及其后的第 1 条“目的”，规定具体义务和各机构职责的执行性条款并未包含在已发布的内容中。
timeline.text_en:
The White House published a presidential executive order titled "Inaugurating The Era Of Super Intelligence" on its Presidential Actions page, dated September 2026. The text released so far contains Section 1 (Purpose), which states that America "stands at the forefront of a new technological revolution in intelligence" and notes that the modern field of artificial intelligence was born in the United States.

As an executive order signed by the President under constitutional and statutory authority, it sets federal policy direction directly without requiring congressional approval. Framing AI development as a "superintelligence" era places frontier AI at the center of the instrument's stated purpose.

Only Section 1 (Purpose), preceded by the standard vesting clause, is included in the released text; the operative sections that would set out specific obligations and agency responsibilities are not part of the published excerpt.

threads.title_en: Binance will hold some Brazil crypto deposits until users explain where the money came from
threads.summary_zh: 自11月1日起，币安将要求巴西用户申报跨境加密转账的用途和交易对手，未完成问卷的提款将被阻止，信息不完整的存款可能被退回，并向巴西央行按月报告；部分转账若对手方未获巴西外汇授权，上限为10万美元。
threads.summary_en: From Nov. 1, Binance will require Brazilian users to declare the purpose and counterparty of cross-border crypto transfers, block withdrawals without the questionnaire, potentially return incomplete deposits, report transactions monthly to Brazil's central bank, and cap some transfers at $100,000 where the counterparty is not FX-authorized in Brazil.

threads.title_zh: Kolibri 是 Aleph Alpha 推出的面向德语和英语的开源权重 LLM
threads.title_en: Kolibri is an open-weight LLM from Aleph Alpha for German and English
threads.summary_zh: Aleph Alpha 发布并开源 Kolibri，一个面向德语和英语的 MoE 大语言模型。总参数 781 亿，每 token 激活约 34.6 亿，权重以 Apache 2.0 协议上传 Hugging Face。支持工具调用和可调节推理模式，上下文最高可扩展到约 100 万 tokens（实际训练到 26.2 万）。官方技术报告详细披露数据集与训练方法。
threads.summary_en: Aleph Alpha released and open-sourced Kolibri, a German-English MoE LLM. It has 78.1B total parameters and ~3.46B active per token, with weights on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0. It supports tool calling and adjustable reasoning, with context extendable to ~1M tokens (trained to 262K). The official technical report details dataset and training recipe.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新细节：Kolibri 采用 MoE 架构，总参数 781 亿，每 token 激活约 34.6 亿；权重以 Apache 2.0 协议上传 Hugging Face；支持工具调用、可调推理模式；上下文可扩展至约 100 万 tokens（实际训练到 26.2 万）；官方评测 AIME 2025 96.9%、LiveCodeBench v6 85.9%。
threads.latest_update_en: New details: Kolibri uses MoE architecture with 78.1B total and 3.46B active parameters per token; weights on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0; supports tool calling and adjustable reasoning; context extendable to ~1M tokens (trained to 262K); official benchmarks AIME 2025 96.9%, LiveCodeBench v6 85.9%.
threads.background_zh: Aleph Alpha GmbH 是一家德国 AI 初创公司，开发大语言模型，并强调其结果生成来源的透明度，产品面向欧洲企业与公共机构。所谓开源权重 LLM，是指训练后的参数被公开发布，其许可证通常允许下载、运行、微调乃至商用。“主权 AI”一般指企业或机构自行掌控模型、数据流、质量与运营，而非完全交由外部供应商。
threads.background_en: Aleph Alpha GmbH is a German AI startup that develops large language models and says it emphasizes transparency of the sources used to generate its results, with products aimed at European enterprises and public institutions. An open-weight LLM is one whose trained parameters are published under a license that typically permits downloading, running, fine-tuning and commercial use. "Sovereign AI" generally refers to retaining control over models, data flows, quality and operations rather than delegating them entirely to an outside provider.
threads.latest_summary_zh: German AI company Aleph Alpha open-sourced Kolibri, an English-German MoE model with 78.1B total and 3.46B active parameters under Apache 2.0, supporting tool calling, adjustable reasoning, and context extendable to roughly 1M tokens (trained to 262K).
threads.latest_summary_en: German AI company Aleph Alpha open-sourced Kolibri, an English-German MoE model with 78.1B total and 3.46B active parameters under Apache 2.0, supporting tool calling, adjustable reasoning, and context extendable to roughly 1M tokens (trained to 262K).
threads.discussion_zh: Hacker News 讨论帖（306 分、125 条评论）总体上称赞该报告的透明度，有评论者称这是第一次见到如此程度的开放。也有人讨论主权模型应当擅长什么——有人主张其核心作用是以“信任适配器”的方式审计其他模型的输出——还有评论者认为该贴文应提及公司与加拿大企业 Cohere 的合并计划。批评集中在基准对比上：有评论者称，模型选择与约一年前发布的 Qwen3-Next 80B-A3B 对比，却未与 Qwen3.8 Flash 比较，这一点相当刺眼；另有评论者则直接贬低 Aleph Alpha，认为其已未能追上其他实验室。
threads.discussion_en: The Hacker News thread (306 points, 125 comments) largely praised the report's transparency, with one commenter calling it the first time they had seen this level of openness. Others debated what a sovereign model needs to do — one argued its main job is auditing other models' outputs as a "trust adapter" — and a commenter said the post should have mentioned the company's planned merger with Canadian firm Cohere. Criticism focused on benchmarking, with one commenter calling the absence of a comparison to Qwen3.8 Flash striking given the model was instead compared with the roughly year-old Qwen3-Next 80B-A3B, and another dismissing Aleph Alpha as having failed to catch up with rival labs.

timeline.text_zh:

threads.title_zh: 白宫成立「超级智能」工作组，将在120天内评估AI风险与机遇
threads.title_en: 白宫成立「超级智能」工作组，将在120天内评估AI风险与机遇
threads.summary_zh: 白宫已成立「超级智能工作组」（SIF），由国家情报总监、联邦贸易委员会主席、战争部研究与工程副部长兼首席技术官、人事管理办公室主任共同领导，向总统和白宫幕僚长汇报，并承担120天内评估AI风险与机遇、协调联邦政府工作、确保美国在超级智能领域领先的任务。
threads.summary_en: The White House has formed a 'Superintelligence Working Group' (SIF), co-led by the Director of National Intelligence, FTC Chair, DoD Under Secretary for Research and Engineering/CTO, and OPM Director, reporting to the President and White House Chief of Staff, tasked with a 120-day assessment of AI risks and opportunities, coordinating federal efforts, and preserving US leadership in superintelligence.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新增工作组的领导层构成：由国家情报总监、联邦贸易委员会主席、战争部研究与工程副部长兼首席技术官、人事管理办公室主任共同领导，并向总统和白宫幕僚长汇报。
threads.latest_update_en: Added the working group's leadership composition: co-led by the Director of National Intelligence, FTC Chair, DoD Under Secretary for Research and Engineering/CTO, and OPM Director, reporting to the President and White House Chief of Staff.
threads.latest_summary_zh: President Trump announced the formation of a Superintelligence Working Group (SIF) to coordinate federal government efforts and preserve US leadership in superintelligence, led by the Director of National Intelligence, the FTC chair, a Defense Department R&E official and the OPM director, reporting to the President and White House Chief of Staff.
threads.latest_summary_en: President Trump announced the formation of a Superintelligence Working Group (SIF) to coordinate federal government efforts and preserve US leadership in superintelligence, led by the Director of National Intelligence, the FTC chair, a Defense Department R&E official and the OPM director, reporting to the President and White House Chief of Staff.

timeline.text_zh: 新增工作组的领导层构成：由国家情报总监、联邦贸易委员会主席、战争部研究与工程副部长兼首席技术官、人事管理办公室主任共同领导，并向总统和白宫幕僚长汇报。
timeline.text_en: Added the working group's leadership composition: co-led by the Director of National Intelligence, FTC Chair, DoD Under Secretary for Research and Engineering/CTO, and OPM Director, reporting to the President and White House Chief of Staff.

timeline.text_zh: 白宫已组建由美国国家情报总监担任主席的“超级智能部队”，责成其在120天内评估AI的风险与机遇、联邦机构的角色以及美国在超级智能领域的领导地位，同时防范过度监管和监管俘获。
timeline.text_en: The White House has formed a 'Super Intelligence Force' chaired by the Director of National Intelligence, tasking it with a 120-day assessment of AI risks and opportunities, federal agency roles, and US leadership in superintelligence while guarding against over-regulation and regulatory capture.

threads.title_zh: Hyperliquid AQAv2储备机制完成首笔约1450万美元USDC收益分配用于回购HYPE
threads.title_en: 【Hyperliquid 明日将收到首笔 AQAv2 储备收益分配，约 1450 万美元用于回购 HYPE】
threads.summary_zh: Hyperliquid 的 AQAv2 国库机制于 10 月 3 日完成首笔 1458 万美元 USDC 支付——资金用于援助基金回购 HYPE——按当前规模估算，这建立了一条年化约 1.93 亿美元的储备收益收入流。
threads.summary_en: Hyperliquid's AQAv2 treasury mechanism completed its first $14.58M USDC payment on Oct 3 — funds directed to the assistance fund for HYPE buybacks — establishing a reserve-yield revenue stream estimated at roughly $193M annualized at current scale.
threads.latest_update_zh: Hyperliquid 的 AQAv2 国库机制于 10 月 3 日完成首笔 1458 万美元 USDC 支付——资金用于援助基金回购 HYPE——按当前规模估算，这建立了一条年化约 1.93 亿美元的储备收益收入流。
threads.latest_update_en: Hyperliquid's AQAv2 treasury mechanism completed its first $14.58M USDC payment on Oct 3 — funds directed to the assistance fund for HYPE buybacks — establishing a reserve-yield revenue stream estimated at roughly $193M annualized at current scale.
threads.background_zh: Hyperliquid的AQAv2稳定币模型此前已获得26个验证者中19个的支持，相关机制预计自8月26日起正式产生收益。Circle已在Hyperliquid的HyperEVM网络上发行原生USDC，并首次投资HYPE代币。Hyperliquid将绝大部分永续合约和现货手续费收入输送至援助基金，用于买入HYPE。
threads.background_en: Hyperliquid's AQAv2 stablecoin model received support from 19 of 26 validators, and the mechanism was expected to begin accruing yields on Aug 26. Circle has issued native USDC on Hyperliquid's HyperEVM network and made its first investment in the HYPE token. Hyperliquid routes the bulk of its perpetual and spot fees to the Assistance Fund, which buys back HYPE.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Hyperliquid's AQAv2 treasury mechanism completed its first $14.58M USDC payment on Oct 3 — funds directed to the assistance fund for HYPE buybacks — establishing a reserve-yield revenue stream estimated at roughly $193M annualized at current scale.
threads.latest_summary_en: Hyperliquid's AQAv2 treasury mechanism completed its first $14.58M USDC payment on Oct 3 — funds directed to the assistance fund for HYPE buybacks — establishing a reserve-yield revenue stream estimated at roughly $193M annualized at current scale.
threads.market_impact_zh: AQAv2付款将Hyperliquid上持有的USDC余额与协议收入相连接，而收入进入援助基金，因此跨链USDC供应量和保证金余额的增长会直接传导至HYPE的回购活动。由于Circle在HyperEVM上发行USDC，且Circle与Coinbase各质押50万枚HYPE并附带逾期罚没条款，相关发行方也对这一机制的运行承担敞口。
threads.market_impact_en: The AQAv2 payout ties USDC balances held on Hyperliquid to protocol revenue that flows into the Assistance Fund, so growth in bridged USDC supply and margin balances feeds directly into HYPE buyback activity. Because Circle issues the USDC on HyperEVM and Circle and Coinbase have each staked 500,000 HYPE with penalty provisions for late payment, those issuers also carry exposure to the mechanism's operation.

timeline.text_en: Hyperliquid's AQAv2 treasury mechanism completed its first $14.58M USDC payment on Oct 3 — funds directed to the assistance fund for HYPE buybacks — establishing a reserve-yield revenue stream estimated at roughly $193M annualized at current scale.

timeline.text_zh: Hyperliquid 预计将于 10 月 3 日收到首笔 AQAv2 储备收入分配——约 1450 万美元的 USDC 收益——资金将流入援助基金用于回购 HYPE。
timeline.text_en: Hyperliquid is expected to receive its first AQAv2 reserve revenue distribution — roughly $14.5 million in USDC yield — on October 3, with the funds flowing into the Assistance Fund to buy back HYPE.

threads.title_zh: OpenPayd在计划纳斯达克上市前获得美国43个州的货币传输许可证 - Pulse 2.0
threads.title_en: OpenPayd Acquires 43 U.S. State Money Transmitter Licenses Ahead Of Planned Nasdaq Listing - Pulse 2.0
threads.summary_zh: OpenPayd 已获得美国 43 个州的货币传输牌照，并预计与 Titan Acquisition Corp. 的 SPAC 合并将于年底前完成，以代码 OP 在纳斯达克上市，预估股权价值最高 11 亿美元，交易尚待 SEC 及股东批准。
threads.summary_en: OpenPayd has obtained money transmitter licenses in 43 U.S. states and expects its SPAC merger with Titan Acquisition Corp. to close by year-end, listing on Nasdaq under ticker OP with a pro forma equity value up to $1.1 billion, pending SEC and shareholder approvals.
threads.latest_update_zh: OpenPayd 预计与 Titan Acquisition Corp. 的合并将于年底前完成，以代码 OP 在纳斯达克上市，预估股权价值最高达 11 亿美元，交易尚待 SEC 注册文件生效及 Titan 股东批准；计划在 2027 年 4 月前在美国推出服务。
threads.latest_update_en: OpenPayd expects its merger with Titan Acquisition Corp. to close by year-end, listing on Nasdaq under ticker OP at a pro forma equity value up to $1.1 billion, pending SEC registration effectiveness and Titan shareholder approval; plans to launch US services by April 2027.
threads.background_zh: SPAC（特殊目的收购公司）通过 IPO 募集资金，随后与实体目标公司合并，这条路径的完成速度通常快于传统 IPO。OpenPayd 处于稳定币支付基础设施领域，为企业提供合规的资金收发与结算通道。
threads.background_en: A SPAC, or special-purpose acquisition company, raises capital through an IPO and then merges with an operating target, a route that can close faster than a traditional IPO. OpenPayd operates in the stablecoin payments infrastructure segment, providing regulated rails for businesses to send, receive and settle funds.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Stablecoin payment infrastructure platform OpenPayd expects its merger with Titan Acquisition Corp. to close by year-end, listing on Nasdaq under the ticker OP at a pro forma equity value of up to $1.1 billion, with proceeds aimed at US expansion, licensing and acquisitions.
threads.latest_summary_en: Stablecoin payment infrastructure platform OpenPayd expects its merger with Titan Acquisition Corp. to close by year-end, listing on Nasdaq under the ticker OP at a pro forma equity value of up to $1.1 billion, with proceeds aimed at US expansion, licensing and acquisitions.
threads.market_impact_zh: 这一上市路径指向加密市场中的稳定币与支付基础设施板块：稳定币支付服务商获得纳斯达克上市载体，可能使公开股票市场对相关板块的敞口从代币扩展到股权，但交易完成仍取决于 SEC 注册生效与股东批准。
threads.market_impact_en: The listing path touches the stablecoin and payments-infrastructure segment of crypto markets: a public Nasdaq vehicle for a stablecoin payments provider could broaden listed-market exposure to the sector through equity rather than tokens, while the deal's completion remains contingent on SEC effectiveness and shareholder approval.

threads.title_zh: Arbitrum因紧急安全行动暂停新的Stylus激活
threads.title_en: Arbitrum Pauses New Stylus Activations in Emergency Security Action
threads.summary_zh: Arbitrum已于10月2日通过安全委员会紧急暂停Arbitrum One和Nova上的新Stylus激活，原因是通过手写WebAssembly进行的AI辅助攻击风险上升。现有Stylus程序可继续运行并续期，普通Solidity合约不受影响；暂停通过提高激活Gas费实现，无需升级ArbOS。未发现可盗取用户资金的攻击。BoLD一步证明防护机制可在接受矛盾证明时延迟未确认的提款，但需满足冲突条件才会暂停结算。恢复激活的日期未定。
threads.summary_en: Arbitrum paused new Stylus activations on Arbitrum One and Nova on October 2 via Security Council emergency action, citing rising risks from AI-assisted attacks via hand-crafted WebAssembly. Existing Stylus programs keep running and can be renewed; ordinary Solidity contracts unaffected. Pause implemented by raising activation gas to prohibitively expensive level, no ArbOS upgrade. No attack enabling theft of user funds discovered. BoLD one-step proof guard can delay unconfirmed withdrawals if conflicting proofs accepted, but pause of settlement depends on condition. No date for restoring activations.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充了暂停范围（Arbitrum One和Nova）、原因（AI辅助攻击通过手写WebAssembly）、通过提高激活Gas费至天文数字实现暂停、无需升级ArbOS、现有Stylus程序可继续续期、未发现可盗取用户资金的攻击、BoLD防护条件等细节。
threads.latest_update_en: New report adds details: pause applies to Arbitrum One and Nova; attributed to AI-assisted attacks via hand-crafted WebAssembly; implemented by raising activation gas to prohibitively expensive level; no ArbOS upgrade; existing Stylus programs can use keepalive renewal; no attack enabling theft of user funds discovered; BoLD guard condition.
threads.background_zh: Stylus是Arbitrum的智能合约系统，允许开发者使用可编译为WebAssembly的语言（如Rust、C和C++）编写兼容EVM的合约。BoLD（Bounded Liquidity Delay，有界流动性延迟）是Arbitrum的争议协议，用于实现无需许可的验证，目前已部署在Arbitrum One、Arbitrum Nova和Arbitrum Sepolia上。
threads.background_en: Stylus is Arbitrum's smart contract system that lets developers write EVM-compatible contracts in languages compiling to WebAssembly, such as Rust, C and C++. BoLD (Bounded Liquidity Delay) is Arbitrum's dispute protocol enabling permissionless validation, and it is active on Arbitrum One, Arbitrum Nova and Arbitrum Sepolia.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Arbitrum's Security Council paused new Stylus contract activations across Arbitrum One and Nova on October 2, citing increasingly sophisticated AI-assisted attacks via hand-crafted WebAssembly, while already-active Stylus programs and ordinary Solidity contracts continue to operate.
threads.latest_summary_en: Arbitrum's Security Council paused new Stylus contract activations across Arbitrum One and Nova on October 2, citing increasingly sophisticated AI-assisted attacks via hand-crafted WebAssembly, while already-active Stylus programs and ordinary Solidity contracts continue to operate.
threads.market_impact_zh: Arbitrum是规模最大的Layer 2网络之一，因此暂停新的Stylus激活会影响面向开发者的合约部署流程，而BoLD防护机制则涉及提款与跨链桥环节，未确认的提款可能被放慢。市场反应主要通过ARB情绪以及用户和开发者对Arbitrum跨链桥延迟的信心传导。
threads.market_impact_en: Arbitrum is one of the largest Layer 2 networks, so a pause on new Stylus activations affects the developer-facing contract deployment pipeline, while the BoLD guard touches the withdrawal and bridging segment where unconfirmed exits could be slowed. Any market reaction would transmit mainly through sentiment toward ARB and through user and developer confidence in Arbitrum bridge latency.

timeline.text_zh: 新报道补充了暂停范围（Arbitrum One和Nova）、原因（AI辅助攻击通过手写WebAssembly）、通过提高激活Gas费至天文数字实现暂停、无需升级ArbOS、现有Stylus程序可继续续期、未发现可盗取用户资金的攻击、BoLD防护条件等细节。
timeline.text_en: New report adds details: pause applies to Arbitrum One and Nova; attributed to AI-assisted attacks via hand-crafted WebAssembly; implemented by raising activation gas to prohibitively expensive level; no ArbOS upgrade; existing Stylus programs can use keepalive renewal; no attack enabling theft of user funds discovered; BoLD guard condition.

timeline.text_zh:
Arbitrum已作为紧急安全措施暂停新的Stylus激活。此外，一项新的BoLD防护机制若接受相互矛盾的证明，可能会延迟尚未确认的提款。

此次暂停使新的Stylus合约无法在Arbitrum上激活，而现有合约仍可继续运行和续期；同时BoLD防护机制引入了一条新路径，可能使等待确认的提款被延迟。

现有活跃合约仍可继续运行和续期。此次行动中没有用户资金损失的报道。
timeline.text_en: Arbitrum paused new Stylus activations as an emergency security measure, while a new BoLD guard could delay unconfirmed withdrawals if contradictory proofs are accepted.

threads.title_zh: Aave 提议设立法律实体以将协议知识产权置于 DAO 治理之下
threads.title_en: Aave Proposes Legal Entity to Place Protocol IP Under DAO Governance
threads.summary_zh: Aave 提议设立一个专门的法律实体，代表其 DAO 持有该协议的知识产权，这是 DeFi 最大借贷协议之一的结构性治理变更。
threads.summary_en: Aave has proposed establishing a dedicated legal entity to hold the protocol's intellectual property on behalf of its DAO, a structural governance change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.
threads.latest_update_zh: Aave 提议设立一个专门的法律实体，代表其 DAO 持有该协议的知识产权，这是 DeFi 最大借贷协议之一的结构性治理变更。
threads.latest_update_en: Aave has proposed establishing a dedicated legal entity to hold the protocol's intellectual property on behalf of its DAO, a structural governance change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.
threads.background_zh: Aave 是一个非托管的 DeFi 借贷协议，利率由供需算法决定，是规模最大的去中心化借贷协议之一。基金会等法律载体被普遍用于让 DAO 持有和保护商标、域名等知识产权，并与链下世界互动，同时协议仍由链上治理运行。
threads.background_en: Aave is a non-custodial DeFi lending protocol where interest rates are set algorithmically by supply and demand, and it is among the largest decentralized lending protocols. Legal wrappers such as foundations are commonly used so that a DAO can hold and protect intellectual property like trademarks and domain names and interact with the off-chain world, while on-chain governance continues to run the protocol.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Aave has proposed establishing a dedicated legal entity to hold the protocol's intellectual property on behalf of its DAO, a structural governance change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.
threads.latest_summary_en: Aave has proposed establishing a dedicated legal entity to hold the protocol's intellectual property on behalf of its DAO, a structural governance change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.
threads.market_impact_zh: 该提案涉及 Aave 品牌与代码库的法律所有权，而非协议流动性，因此市场传导路径主要在治理与法律结构层面：提案声明 AAVE 持有者的现有投票权不变，而更清晰的法律载体可能影响交易对手、贡献者与机构参与者同协议互动的方式。ARFC 阶段本身不会改变抵押资产、上币安排或代币供应。
threads.market_impact_en: The proposal concerns the legal ownership of Aave's brand and codebase rather than protocol liquidity, so any market transmission runs through governance and legal structure: AAVE holders' existing voting rights are stated as unchanged, while a clearer legal wrapper could affect how counterparties, contributors and institutional participants engage with the protocol. The ARFC stage itself does not alter collateral, listings or token supply.

timeline.text_en: Aave Labs proposed creating a Cayman Islands foundation with independent officers as a first phase toward transferring Aave's brand, trademarks, domains and codebase to DAO governance, with the actual asset transfers subject to later governance votes.

focus.title_zh: CFTC 提出 CTX 与 CAM 规则并推进预测市场事件合约定义
focus.title_en: CFTC Proposes CTX and CAM Rules to Establish Federal Crypto Exchange Framework
focus.summary_zh: CFTC已发布立即生效的临时最终规则及一项新规提案，将预测市场事件合约纳入掉期监管框架，从而升级与各州之间的管辖权争端。
focus.summary_en: The CFTC has issued an immediately effective interim final rule and a proposed rule to bring prediction-market event contracts under its swaps regulatory framework, escalating its jurisdiction dispute with states.
focus.latest_update_zh: CFTC发布了一项立即生效的临时最终规则，并提出另一项新规，拟将Kalshi和Polymarket等平台的预测市场事件合约纳入其掉期监管框架；临时最终规则已立即生效但仍接受公众意见，新规提案则有30天意见征询期。
focus.latest_update_en: The CFTC issued an immediately effective interim final rule and proposed a new rule to bring prediction-market event contracts on platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket under its swaps regulatory framework; the interim final rule is effective immediately but remains open to comment, while the proposed rule has a 30-day comment period.
focus.background_zh: 参议院未能达到推进《CLARITY 法案》所需的 60 票门槛，该法案本将为数字资产建立法定框架。美国加密交易目前要么适用为其他市场制定的规则，要么适用各州不一的地方牌照。CFTC 的这份通知还否定了该机构在拜登时期对 Kraken、Ooki DAO 和 Uniswap 的执法案件，称其为“以执法代替监管”。
focus.background_en: The Senate failed to reach the 60 votes needed to advance the CLARITY Act, which would have created a statutory framework for digital assets. Crypto trading in the US currently runs under rules built for other markets or under state licenses that vary by state. The CFTC notice also disowns the agency's Biden-era cases against Kraken, Ooki DAO and Uniswap as regulation by enforcement.
focus.latest_summary_zh: The CFTC issued an immediately effective interim final rule and proposed a new rule to bring prediction-market event contracts on platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket under its swaps regulatory framework, escalating its federal jurisdiction fight with states.
focus.latest_summary_en: The CFTC issued an immediately effective interim final rule and proposed a new rule to bring prediction-market event contracts on platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket under its swaps regulatory framework, escalating its federal jurisdiction fight with states.
focus.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于美国市场准入：联邦牌照将使本土交易所能够上线目前主要在离岸提供的杠杆及永续类产品，涉及交易所股票、在岸永续合约场所及为其撮合交易的经纪商，而更清晰的规则也会降低银行和券商涉足加密业务的门槛。由于该文件只是开启意见征询期，近期影响限于围绕美国受监管场所的情绪与仓位，而非已生效的规则。
focus.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through US market access: a federal license would let domestic exchanges list leveraged and perpetual-style products now largely offered offshore, putting exchange equities, listed perp venues and the brokers routing those trades in scope, with clear rules also lowering the barrier for banks and brokers to touch crypto. Because the document only opens a comment period, near-term effects are confined to sentiment and positioning around US-regulated venues rather than to rules in force.

reference_links.title: CFTC makes its biggest move yet to bring offshore crypto trading...
CFTC and SEC race on parallel crypto rulebooks
The CLARITY Act Stalls in the Senate: What’s Next for Digital Asset...

timeline.text_zh: CFTC发布了一项立即生效的临时最终规则，并提出另一项新规，拟将Kalshi和Polymarket等平台的预测市场事件合约纳入其掉期监管框架；临时最终规则已立即生效但仍接受公众意见，新规提案则有30天意见征询期。
timeline.text_en: The CFTC issued an immediately effective interim final rule and proposed a new rule to bring prediction-market event contracts on platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket under its swaps regulatory framework; the interim final rule is effective immediately but remains open to comment, while the proposed rule has a 30-day comment period.

timeline.text_zh:
CFTC 公布了一份初步提案，拟通过两项新规——Regulation CTX 与 Regulation CAM——建立加密交易所的联邦许可框架，文件在《联邦公报》刊登后将开启为期 60 天的公众意见征询期。此时距《Clarity 法案》在参议院夭折已有三周，同日 SEC 还批准了 3 倍杠杆的 BTC 和 ETH 基金上市交易。

该计划提出了单一的联邦许可选择，并以是否涉及杠杆来决定谁需要持牌，这是国会未能通过的框架，将允许美国交易平台提供目前无法提供的保证金类产品。不过这是一份征求意见的初步概念文件，并非具有约束力的规则文本。

牌照将覆盖撮合买卖双方、托管客户资金与加密资产、结算交易以及借贷，每项业务需分别获批；交易将通过已受反洗钱规则约束的经纪商进行，且只有这些经纪商或其保荐银行可以提供杠杆。该机构还在考虑储备金证明要求，以及针对易被操纵代币的上市标准；CFTC 主席 Mike Selig 表示，这些规则的目的是防止类似 FTX 的欺诈，而非事后追诉。
timeline.text_en: The CFTC published a preliminary plan to federally license and regulate crypto exchanges via proposed Regulations CTX and CAM and opened a 60-day public comment period, while the SEC cleared 3x levered Bitcoin and Ether funds for trading.

timeline.text_zh: CFTC通过新的CTX和CAM法规提出了其首套正式加密市场规则，放弃了仅靠执法来监管数字资产市场的方式。
timeline.text_en: The CFTC proposed its first formal crypto market rules through new CTX and CAM regulations, abandoning an enforcement-only approach to regulating digital asset markets.

focus.title_zh: OpenAI发布数学手稿并撤回部分结果
focus.title_en: OpenAI releases mathematics manuscripts and withdraws some results
focus.summary_zh: OpenAI 的数学成果发布在数学界引发广泛震惊与不确定性，许多数学家认为其规模空前，评估需数年时间，相关辩论仍在持续。
focus.summary_en: OpenAI's mathematics release has drawn widespread astonishment and uncertainty among mathematicians, many of whom call the scale unprecedented and say evaluation will take years, with debate ongoing.
focus.latest_update_zh: The Verge 报道称，超过三十多位数学家将 OpenAI 的数学成果发布描述为规模空前，并表示需要数年时间才能充分评估。
focus.latest_update_en: The Verge reported that more than three dozen mathematicians described OpenAI's mathematics release as unprecedented in scale and said it will take years to fully evaluate.
focus.background_zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，OpenAI 曾表示正与一个数学家顾问委员会合作，就 AI 公司在该领域的使用提供建议。近年来，AI 系统已被用于把数学陈述“自动形式化”为机器可检验的代码，并出现了 FrontierMath 等基准，用于在研究级数学问题上测试前沿模型。
focus.background_en: The New York Times reported that OpenAI has said it is working with an advisory board of mathematicians that would offer advice on how AI companies use the technology in the field. In recent years AI systems have been used to autoformalize mathematical statements into machine-checkable code, and benchmarks such as FrontierMath were built to test frontier models on research-level problems.
focus.latest_summary_zh: OpenAI released a large batch of mathematical results that stunned researchers, with more than three dozen mathematicians telling The Verge the output was unprecedented in scale and will take years to fully evaluate.
focus.latest_summary_en: OpenAI released a large batch of mathematical results that stunned researchers, with more than three dozen mathematicians telling The Verge the output was unprecedented in scale and will take years to fully evaluate.
focus.discussion_zh: 在约 481 条评论的 Hacker News 讨论中，读者普遍对未经核验的 AI 生成证明持怀疑态度。多位评论者认为，如此规模的成果发布应当全部形式化；Lean 证明也可能通过编译却陈述了与原本意图不同的内容；若没有一个活跃的人类数学共同体，这类问题可能要多年后才会被发现。还有一位评论者对一项声称达到 O(n log n) 的整数乘法结果提出疑问。
focus.discussion_en: In a Hacker News thread of about 481 comments, readers were broadly skeptical of unverified AI-generated proofs. Several argued that a release of this scale should be fully formalized, that a Lean proof can compile while still stating something other than what was intended, and that without a thriving human mathematical community such problems could go unnoticed for years; one commenter also questioned a claimed O(n log n) integer-multiplication result.
focus.market_impact_zh: 一批数学成果本身并没有直接传导至加密市场的路径；若有影响，也主要通过 AI 相关加密板块（如去中心化算力、AI 代理类代币）的情绪，这些板块围绕前沿模型能力的叙事进行交易。由于成果尚未得到验证，它们本身并不会改变这些资产的基本面。
focus.market_impact_en: A batch of mathematical results has no direct transmission channel to crypto markets; any effect would run through sentiment for AI-linked crypto segments such as decentralized compute and AI-agent tokens, which trade on narratives about frontier-model capability. Because the results are unverified, they do not by themselves change the fundamentals of those assets.

timeline.text_zh: The Verge 报道称，超过三十多位数学家将 OpenAI 的数学成果发布描述为规模空前，并表示需要数年时间才能充分评估。
timeline.text_en: The Verge reported that more than three dozen mathematicians described OpenAI's mathematics release as unprecedented in scale and said it will take years to fully evaluate.

timeline.text_zh: Asaf Karagila的一篇博客文章批评OpenAI的数学发布及其对数学研究文化的影响，引发Hacker News上关于AI生成证明和数学家责任的辩论。
timeline.text_en: A blog post by Asaf Karagila critiques OpenAI's mathematical releases and their effect on mathematical research culture, sparking a Hacker News debate about AI-generated proofs and the responsibilities of mathematicians.

timeline.text_zh:
据 @danintheory 在 X 上发布的帖子及 openai/math 仓库的 history 文件，OpenAI 已从其数学仓库中撤回三项数学成果。该仓库收录由 OpenAI 内部模型生成的数学手稿及相关证明工件。

此次撤回使外界关注 AI 生成数学证明的可信度问题，尤其是那些以自然语言给出、而非附有可机器检验的 Lean 证书的成果。

openai/math 仓库共收录 722 篇手稿、分属 372 个成果系列，以 Apache-2.0 许可发布。其中部分证明包含可供计算机检验的 Lean 形式化内容，另一部分则没有。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI withdrew three math papers from its public repository, spotlighting questions about the reliability and formal verification of AI-generated mathematical proofs.

focus.title_zh: OpenAI发布GPT-6系列模型并推进产品更新
focus.title_en: OpenAI releases GPT-6 family models and rolls out product updates
focus.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 28 天产品冲刺第 4 天将 GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast 推向 API、Codex 和 ChatGPT Work，Codex 生成速度最高达标准模式 8 倍，API 定价为标准档 6 倍；Codex 还新增任务执行中途实时纠偏能力。
focus.summary_en: On Day 4 of OpenAI's 28-day product sprint, OpenAI rolled out GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast to API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work, with up to 8x faster generation in Codex and API pricing at 6x standard; Codex also gained real-time mid-task redirect capability.
focus.latest_update_zh: OpenAI 在 28 天产品冲刺第 4 天推出 GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast，向 API、Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 推送，Codex 中生成速度最高达标准模式的 8 倍，API 价格为标准档的 6 倍；同时改进 Codex 中途纠偏功能，允许用户在 Agent 执行任务时补充要求或纠正方向。
focus.latest_update_en: On Day 4 of OpenAI's 28-day product sprint, OpenAI rolled out GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast to API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work, with up to 8x faster generation in Codex and API pricing at 6x standard; it also improved Codex mid-task redirect, letting users add requests or correct direction while the agent is executing.
focus.background_zh: GPT-6是OpenAI在GPT-5系列之后推出的新一代主力模型。“智能界面”这一思路延续了生成式界面（generative UI）的概念，即由模型根据提示或上下文生成界面元素，而不仅仅是文字。
focus.background_en: GPT-6 is OpenAI's next major model in the GPT series, following the GPT-5 family. The 'Intelligent UI' concept extends the idea of generative UI, in which a model generates interface elements — not just text — in response to a prompt or context.
focus.latest_summary_zh: OpenAI rolled out GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast to its API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work with up to 8x faster generation in Codex at 6x standard token pricing, alongside a new Codex feature letting users redirect agent tasks mid-execution.
focus.latest_summary_en: OpenAI rolled out GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast to its API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work with up to 8x faster generation in Codex at 6x standard token pricing, alongside a new Codex feature letting users redirect agent tasks mid-execution.
focus.market_impact_zh: ChatGPT是消费级AI的重要分发渠道，因此其平台层面转向可交互、可渲染的回答形式，主要通过情绪面对加密市场中的AI叙事板块产生关联，而非源于任何已公布的加密集成。现有材料中未提及直接的托管、流动性或链上关联。
focus.market_impact_en: ChatGPT is a major distribution channel for consumer AI, so a platform-wide shift toward interactive, rendered answers touches the AI-narrative segment of crypto markets mainly through sentiment rather than any announced crypto integration. No direct custody, liquidity or on-chain linkage is described in the available material.

timeline.text_en: OpenAI globally launched GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for all ChatGPT users, letting the model blend text, visual content, and interactive elements and generate in-conversation tools such as games and interactive budget calculators.

timeline.text_en: On Day 3 of OpenAI's 28-day product sprint, GPT-6 launched inside the ChatGPT chat interface first for Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users (Free and Go to follow), alongside news that Codex and ChatGPT Work together hit 40 million active users and that all paid accounts will receive a one-time banked usage reset valid for a month.

focus.title_zh: Blast 宣布停止 Layer 2 运营并要求用户提取资产
focus.title_en: Bithumb将BLAST列入交易注意名单，因Blast宣布主网运营结束计划
focus.summary_zh: Blast 因维护成本超过收入而停止运营，用户需在 10 月 26 日前通过常规界面将资产撤回以太坊主网；提现等待时间计划缩短至 24 小时，但团队先退出其 Lido 资产，预计约一周内提现功能暂时不可用，截止后仍可通过以太坊 L1 上的 Blast Bridge 合约提取。Bithumb 与 Upbit 已将 BLAST 列入交易注意名单并暂停充值；Coinbase 发布状态更新，要求用户在 10 月 26 日前将 BLAST 转出，媒体报道其将于 10 月 20 日暂停 BLAST 交易。
focus.summary_en: Blast is ceasing operations because maintenance costs exceed revenue; users need to withdraw assets to Ethereum mainnet via the standard interface by Oct. 26; withdrawal wait time is planned to be shortened to 24 hours, but withdrawals are temporarily unavailable for about a week while Blast exits its Lido holdings, and after the deadline assets can still be withdrawn via the Blast Bridge contract on Ethereum L1. Bithumb and Upbit added BLAST to trading-caution watchlists and suspended deposits; Coinbase posted a status update requiring users to move BLAST off Coinbase by Oct. 26, with media reports that it will suspend BLAST trading on Oct. 20.
focus.latest_update_zh: Coinbase 于 10 月 7 日发布状态更新，确认 Blast 网络正在被项目团队关停，并要求用户必须在 2026 年 10 月 26 日前将 BLAST 转出 Coinbase，否则网络关停后将无法访问这些资产；媒体报道称 Coinbase 将于 10 月 20 日暂停 BLAST 交易。
focus.latest_update_en: Coinbase posted a status update on Oct 7 confirming the Blast network is being shut down by the project team and requiring users to move BLAST off Coinbase before Oct 26, 2026, or lose access after shutdown; media reports say Coinbase will suspend BLAST trading on Oct 20.
focus.background_zh: Blast 是一条以太坊二层网络，在 2024 年 2 月主网上线时吸引了 23 亿美元存款，最初主打 ETH 与稳定币持仓的原生收益。有报道称，团队于 2026 年 10 月 2 日宣布逐步关停，理由是运营成本已超过二层网络收入，且看不到可信的经济可持续路径。
focus.background_en: Blast is an Ethereum layer-2 network that drew $2.3 billion in deposits by its February 2024 mainnet launch and initially pitched native yield on ETH and stablecoin holdings. Reports say the team announced the wind-down on October 2, 2026, citing operating costs that exceed L2 revenue with no credible path to economic sustainability.
focus.latest_summary_zh:
Coinbase 于 10 月 7 日 15:50（太平洋时间）发布状态更新，称 Blast 项目团队正在关停 Blast 网络，用户必须采取操作以避免失去资金访问权限。Coinbase 表示，若未在 2026 年 10 月 26 日之前将 BLAST 转出该交易所，网络关停后将无法再访问这些资产。

该通知把网络关停变成了对仍将 BLAST 存放在 Coinbase 的用户的硬性截止期限：2026 年 10 月 26 日之后，未转出的资产将无法访问。

Coinbase 将该条目标注为计划内维护，并表示将按需提供更新。有关此次关停的媒体报道称，Coinbase 将于 10 月 20 日暂停 BLAST 交易，早于 10 月 26 日的提现截止日期。
focus.latest_summary_en:
Coinbase posted a status update on October 7 (15:50 PDT) stating that the Blast project team is shutting down the Blast network and that users must act to avoid losing access to their funds. Coinbase said BLAST that is not moved off the exchange before October 26, 2026 will not be accessible to users after the network is shut down.

The notice turns the shutdown into a hard deadline for anyone still holding BLAST on Coinbase: assets left in place become inaccessible after October 26, 2026.

Coinbase labeled the entry as scheduled maintenance and said it would provide updates as necessary. Media reports on the shutdown state that Coinbase suspends BLAST trading on October 20, ahead of the October 26 withdrawal deadline.
focus.market_impact_zh: 传导路径经由交易所托管与提现基础设施：存放在 Coinbase 的 BLAST 必须在截止日期前转出，随着网络关停，资金流将集中到该代币剩余的交易场所与提现通道。这也会影响市场对以太坊二层网络经济模型的情绪，不过此次关停属于有序退出，而非故障或漏洞事件。
focus.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through exchange custody and withdrawal infrastructure: BLAST held on Coinbase must be moved before the deadline, which concentrates flow into the token's remaining trading venues and withdrawal rails as the network winds down. It also feeds sentiment about the economics of Ethereum layer-2 networks, though the shutdown is an orderly sunset rather than a failure or exploit.

focus.title_zh: Solana 主网完成 350ms、300ms、250ms 出块时间削减，并计划激活 200ms 目标
focus.title_en: Solana Activates 350ms Slots on Mainnet, First Cut Since Genesis
focus.summary_zh: SIMD-0525 的 200 毫秒目标已激活并宣布完成，Anza 确认升级落地；社区注意力转向 Alpenglow 共识改造（目标约 150 毫秒最终性），其已在测试网和开发网部署，但主网激活日期尚未公布。
focus.summary_en: The 200-millisecond target of SIMD-0525 has been activated and declared complete by Anza; attention now shifts to the Alpenglow consensus overhaul targeting ~150ms finality, which has been deployed on testnet and devnet but has no announced mainnet activation date.
focus.latest_update_zh: Solana 已于 10 月 9 日在主网激活 200 毫秒出块时间，完成 SIMD-0525 从 400 毫秒起的四阶段缩减，区块生产机会提升至每秒 5 个，epoch 时长由约 48 小时缩短至约 24 小时；同时交易 blockhash 有效期从约 60 秒缩短至约 30 秒。
focus.latest_update_en: Solana activated 200-millisecond slots on mainnet on Oct. 9, completing the four-stage SIMD-0525 reduction from 400ms: block-production opportunities rose to five per second, epoch duration fell from about 48 hours to about 24 hours, and transaction blockhash expiry shrank from about 60 seconds to about 30 seconds.
focus.latest_summary_zh: Solana activated 200-millisecond slots on mainnet, cutting its original 400ms block-production target in half, increasing block opportunities to five per second and shortening epochs to roughly 24 hours ahead of the still-unscheduled Alpenglow upgrade targeting 150ms finality.
focus.latest_summary_en: Solana activated 200-millisecond slots on mainnet, cutting its original 400ms block-production target in half, increasing block opportunities to five per second and shortening epochs to roughly 24 hours ahead of the still-unscheduled Alpenglow upgrade targeting 150ms finality.

timeline.text_zh: Solana 已于 10 月 9 日在主网激活 200 毫秒出块时间，完成 SIMD-0525 从 400 毫秒起的四阶段缩减，区块生产机会提升至每秒 5 个，epoch 时长由约 48 小时缩短至约 24 小时；同时交易 blockhash 有效期从约 60 秒缩短至约 30 秒。
timeline.text_en: Solana activated 200-millisecond slots on mainnet on Oct. 9, completing the four-stage SIMD-0525 reduction from 400ms: block-production opportunities rose to five per second, epoch duration fell from about 48 hours to about 24 hours, and transaction blockhash expiry shrank from about 60 seconds to about 30 seconds.

timeline.text_zh: Solana已在350毫秒后进一步将出块时间降至300毫秒和250毫秒，并计划在epoch 1053将目标出块时间最终降至200毫秒，完成SIMD-0525从400毫秒开始的缩减序列。
timeline.text_en: Solana has progressed beyond the 350ms cut to 300ms and 250ms, and is scheduled to make a final reduction to 200ms target block time at epoch 1053, completing the SIMD-0525 sequence of cuts from 400ms.

timeline.text_zh: Solana 正在安排最后一次削减至 200 毫秒出块时间，通过降低单区块计算上限来补偿，而验证者将面临更频繁的投票和更短的出块窗口。
timeline.text_en: Solana is scheduling its final cut to 200-millisecond slots, compensating with smaller per-block compute limits while validators face more frequent voting and shorter block-production windows.

focus.title_zh: Igloo旗下Abstract L2宣布将于12月15日关停并转向胖企鹅
focus.title_en: Igloo's Abstract L2 to shut down on Dec. 15 and pivot to Pudgy Penguins
focus.summary_zh: Igloo Inc. 正逐步关停 Abstract 链并转向 Pudgy Penguins/PENGU；Abstract L2 已确定 12 月 15 日关停，但各资产迁移通道的截止日期可能更早，用户须尽快操作，否则资金将无法访问；公司放弃通过代币发行救助该链。
focus.summary_en: Igloo Inc. is winding down the Abstract chain and pivoting to Pudgy Penguins/PENGU; Abstract’s Ethereum L2 is set to shut down on Dec. 15, but asset-migration channels may have earlier deadlines, so users must act promptly or funds become inaccessible; the company has forgone a token launch to save the chain.
focus.latest_update_zh: 新报道警示：Abstract 的 12 月 15 日关停伴随各资产迁移通道的提前截止日期，用户需在更早时间发起操作、完成交易和申领权益，仅持有资产不等于能及时转出。
focus.latest_update_en: The report warns that Abstract’s December 15 shutdown comes with earlier deadlines across asset-migration channels, requiring users to initiate operations, complete transactions and claim rights sooner, and that merely holding assets does not guarantee timely withdrawal.
focus.background_zh: Abstract 是由 Pudgy Penguins 母公司 Igloo Inc. 开发的 Layer 2 区块链，基于 zkSync 的 ZK 技术栈并采用 EigenDA，定位为面向消费级应用的网络。Pudgy Penguins 是一个包含 8888 枚 NFT 的系列，其团队还于2024年12月推出了 PENGU 代币。
focus.background_en: Abstract is a Layer 2 blockchain developed by Igloo Inc., the parent company of Pudgy Penguins, and is built on zkSync's ZK stack with EigenDA, targeting consumer-facing web3 applications. Pudgy Penguins is an 8,888-piece NFT collection whose team also issues the PENGU token, launched in December 2024.
focus.latest_summary_zh: Abstract's December 15 shutdown comes with earlier deadlines across its asset-migration channels, warning users that merely holding assets on the chain does not guarantee they can be withdrawn in time.
focus.latest_summary_en: Abstract's December 15 shutdown comes with earlier deadlines across its asset-migration channels, warning users that merely holding assets on the chain does not guarantee they can be withdrawn in time.
focus.market_impact_zh: 此次公告使 Igloo/Pudgy 体系从自营消费级公链转向 Pudgy Penguins 品牌、NFT 与 PENGU 代币，这一资源重配直接关系到上述资产的持有者以及 NFT 市场上的交易者。目前可观察到的市场反应主要限于 NFT 端：单个新地址带来100万美元资金流入，地板价24小时内上涨6.8%至3.3 ETH；至于对 PENGU 代币、Abstract 自身用户与流动性的影响，现有证据尚不足以确认。
focus.market_impact_en: The announcement shifts the Igloo/Pudgy complex away from running its own consumer chain and toward the Pudgy Penguins brand, NFTs and PENGU token, a reallocation that touches holders of those assets and traders on NFT marketplaces. The observed market reaction is limited so far to the NFT side — a $1 million inflow from a single new address and a 6.8% 24-hour floor move to 3.3 ETH — while any effect on the PENGU token or on Abstract's own users and liquidity is not established by the available evidence.

timeline.text_en: The report warns that Abstract’s December 15 shutdown comes with earlier deadlines across asset-migration channels, requiring users to initiate operations, complete transactions and claim rights sooner, and that merely holding assets does not guarantee timely withdrawal.

timeline.text_zh: Abstract 已确定将于 12月15日关停其以太坊 L2，并要求用户在截止前跨链转出资产；Igloo CEO 称已损失数千万美元，并放弃通过发行代币来救助该链。
timeline.text_en: Abstract has set Dec. 15 as the shutdown date for its Ethereum L2, warned users to bridge assets off the chain before then, and Igloo’s CEO said the company lost tens of millions of dollars while forgoing a token launch as a lifeline.

timeline.text_zh: Igloo Inc. 正在逐步关闭其 Abstract 链，全面转向 Pudgy Penguins、Pudgy NFT 和 PENGU。公告发布后不久，一个新地址从 Kraken 转出 100 万美元，抢购了 25 个 Pudgy Penguin NFT。
timeline.text_en: Igloo Inc. is winding down its Abstract chain and pivoting entirely to Pudgy Penguins, Pudgy NFTs and PENGU, with a new address moving $1M off Kraken to snap up 25 Pudgy Penguin NFTs shortly after the announcement.

focus.watch_zh: 关注关停前的资产退出安排；已收录报道给出的关停日期为 12 月 15 日。
focus.watch_en: Watch asset exit arrangements before the December 15 shutdown date stated in retained coverage.

ranking.title_zh: CFTC 提出 CTX 与 CAM 规则并推进预测市场事件合约定义
ranking.title_en: CFTC Proposes CTX and CAM Rules to Establish Federal Crypto Exchange Framework
ranking.summary_zh: CFTC已发布立即生效的临时最终规则及一项新规提案，将预测市场事件合约纳入掉期监管框架，从而升级与各州之间的管辖权争端。
ranking.summary_en: The CFTC has issued an immediately effective interim final rule and a proposed rule to bring prediction-market event contracts under its swaps regulatory framework, escalating its jurisdiction dispute with states.
ranking.latest_update_zh: CFTC发布了一项立即生效的临时最终规则，并提出另一项新规，拟将Kalshi和Polymarket等平台的预测市场事件合约纳入其掉期监管框架；临时最终规则已立即生效但仍接受公众意见，新规提案则有30天意见征询期。
ranking.latest_update_en: The CFTC issued an immediately effective interim final rule and proposed a new rule to bring prediction-market event contracts on platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket under its swaps regulatory framework; the interim final rule is effective immediately but remains open to comment, while the proposed rule has a 30-day comment period.
ranking.background_zh: 参议院未能达到推进《CLARITY 法案》所需的 60 票门槛，该法案本将为数字资产建立法定框架。美国加密交易目前要么适用为其他市场制定的规则，要么适用各州不一的地方牌照。CFTC 的这份通知还否定了该机构在拜登时期对 Kraken、Ooki DAO 和 Uniswap 的执法案件，称其为“以执法代替监管”。
ranking.background_en: The Senate failed to reach the 60 votes needed to advance the CLARITY Act, which would have created a statutory framework for digital assets. Crypto trading in the US currently runs under rules built for other markets or under state licenses that vary by state. The CFTC notice also disowns the agency's Biden-era cases against Kraken, Ooki DAO and Uniswap as regulation by enforcement.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: The CFTC issued an immediately effective interim final rule and proposed a new rule to bring prediction-market event contracts on platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket under its swaps regulatory framework, escalating its federal jurisdiction fight with states.
ranking.latest_summary_en: The CFTC issued an immediately effective interim final rule and proposed a new rule to bring prediction-market event contracts on platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket under its swaps regulatory framework, escalating its federal jurisdiction fight with states.
ranking.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于美国市场准入：联邦牌照将使本土交易所能够上线目前主要在离岸提供的杠杆及永续类产品，涉及交易所股票、在岸永续合约场所及为其撮合交易的经纪商，而更清晰的规则也会降低银行和券商涉足加密业务的门槛。由于该文件只是开启意见征询期，近期影响限于围绕美国受监管场所的情绪与仓位，而非已生效的规则。
ranking.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through US market access: a federal license would let domestic exchanges list leveraged and perpetual-style products now largely offered offshore, putting exchange equities, listed perp venues and the brokers routing those trades in scope, with clear rules also lowering the barrier for banks and brokers to touch crypto. Because the document only opens a comment period, near-term effects are confined to sentiment and positioning around US-regulated venues rather than to rules in force.

timeline.text_zh: CFTC发布了一项立即生效的临时最终规则，并提出另一项新规，拟将Kalshi和Polymarket等平台的预测市场事件合约纳入其掉期监管框架；临时最终规则已立即生效但仍接受公众意见，新规提案则有30天意见征询期。
timeline.text_en: The CFTC issued an immediately effective interim final rule and proposed a new rule to bring prediction-market event contracts on platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket under its swaps regulatory framework; the interim final rule is effective immediately but remains open to comment, while the proposed rule has a 30-day comment period.

timeline.text_zh:
CFTC 公布了一份初步提案，拟通过两项新规——Regulation CTX 与 Regulation CAM——建立加密交易所的联邦许可框架，文件在《联邦公报》刊登后将开启为期 60 天的公众意见征询期。此时距《Clarity 法案》在参议院夭折已有三周，同日 SEC 还批准了 3 倍杠杆的 BTC 和 ETH 基金上市交易。

该计划提出了单一的联邦许可选择，并以是否涉及杠杆来决定谁需要持牌，这是国会未能通过的框架，将允许美国交易平台提供目前无法提供的保证金类产品。不过这是一份征求意见的初步概念文件，并非具有约束力的规则文本。

牌照将覆盖撮合买卖双方、托管客户资金与加密资产、结算交易以及借贷，每项业务需分别获批；交易将通过已受反洗钱规则约束的经纪商进行，且只有这些经纪商或其保荐银行可以提供杠杆。该机构还在考虑储备金证明要求，以及针对易被操纵代币的上市标准；CFTC 主席 Mike Selig 表示，这些规则的目的是防止类似 FTX 的欺诈，而非事后追诉。
timeline.text_en: The CFTC published a preliminary plan to federally license and regulate crypto exchanges via proposed Regulations CTX and CAM and opened a 60-day public comment period, while the SEC cleared 3x levered Bitcoin and Ether funds for trading.

timeline.text_zh: CFTC通过新的CTX和CAM法规提出了其首套正式加密市场规则，放弃了仅靠执法来监管数字资产市场的方式。
timeline.text_en: The CFTC proposed its first formal crypto market rules through new CTX and CAM regulations, abandoning an enforcement-only approach to regulating digital asset markets.

ranking.title_zh: OpenAI发布数学手稿并撤回部分结果
ranking.title_en: OpenAI releases mathematics manuscripts and withdraws some results
ranking.summary_zh: OpenAI 的数学成果发布在数学界引发广泛震惊与不确定性，许多数学家认为其规模空前，评估需数年时间，相关辩论仍在持续。
ranking.summary_en: OpenAI's mathematics release has drawn widespread astonishment and uncertainty among mathematicians, many of whom call the scale unprecedented and say evaluation will take years, with debate ongoing.
ranking.latest_update_zh: The Verge 报道称，超过三十多位数学家将 OpenAI 的数学成果发布描述为规模空前，并表示需要数年时间才能充分评估。
ranking.latest_update_en: The Verge reported that more than three dozen mathematicians described OpenAI's mathematics release as unprecedented in scale and said it will take years to fully evaluate.
ranking.background_zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，OpenAI 曾表示正与一个数学家顾问委员会合作，就 AI 公司在该领域的使用提供建议。近年来，AI 系统已被用于把数学陈述“自动形式化”为机器可检验的代码，并出现了 FrontierMath 等基准，用于在研究级数学问题上测试前沿模型。
ranking.background_en: The New York Times reported that OpenAI has said it is working with an advisory board of mathematicians that would offer advice on how AI companies use the technology in the field. In recent years AI systems have been used to autoformalize mathematical statements into machine-checkable code, and benchmarks such as FrontierMath were built to test frontier models on research-level problems.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: OpenAI released a large batch of mathematical results that stunned researchers, with more than three dozen mathematicians telling The Verge the output was unprecedented in scale and will take years to fully evaluate.
ranking.latest_summary_en: OpenAI released a large batch of mathematical results that stunned researchers, with more than three dozen mathematicians telling The Verge the output was unprecedented in scale and will take years to fully evaluate.
ranking.discussion_zh: 在约 481 条评论的 Hacker News 讨论中，读者普遍对未经核验的 AI 生成证明持怀疑态度。多位评论者认为，如此规模的成果发布应当全部形式化；Lean 证明也可能通过编译却陈述了与原本意图不同的内容；若没有一个活跃的人类数学共同体，这类问题可能要多年后才会被发现。还有一位评论者对一项声称达到 O(n log n) 的整数乘法结果提出疑问。
ranking.discussion_en: In a Hacker News thread of about 481 comments, readers were broadly skeptical of unverified AI-generated proofs. Several argued that a release of this scale should be fully formalized, that a Lean proof can compile while still stating something other than what was intended, and that without a thriving human mathematical community such problems could go unnoticed for years; one commenter also questioned a claimed O(n log n) integer-multiplication result.
ranking.market_impact_zh: 一批数学成果本身并没有直接传导至加密市场的路径；若有影响，也主要通过 AI 相关加密板块（如去中心化算力、AI 代理类代币）的情绪，这些板块围绕前沿模型能力的叙事进行交易。由于成果尚未得到验证，它们本身并不会改变这些资产的基本面。
ranking.market_impact_en: A batch of mathematical results has no direct transmission channel to crypto markets; any effect would run through sentiment for AI-linked crypto segments such as decentralized compute and AI-agent tokens, which trade on narratives about frontier-model capability. Because the results are unverified, they do not by themselves change the fundamentals of those assets.

timeline.text_zh: The Verge 报道称，超过三十多位数学家将 OpenAI 的数学成果发布描述为规模空前，并表示需要数年时间才能充分评估。
timeline.text_en: The Verge reported that more than three dozen mathematicians described OpenAI's mathematics release as unprecedented in scale and said it will take years to fully evaluate.

timeline.text_zh: Asaf Karagila的一篇博客文章批评OpenAI的数学发布及其对数学研究文化的影响，引发Hacker News上关于AI生成证明和数学家责任的辩论。
timeline.text_en: A blog post by Asaf Karagila critiques OpenAI's mathematical releases and their effect on mathematical research culture, sparking a Hacker News debate about AI-generated proofs and the responsibilities of mathematicians.

timeline.text_zh:
据 @danintheory 在 X 上发布的帖子及 openai/math 仓库的 history 文件，OpenAI 已从其数学仓库中撤回三项数学成果。该仓库收录由 OpenAI 内部模型生成的数学手稿及相关证明工件。

此次撤回使外界关注 AI 生成数学证明的可信度问题，尤其是那些以自然语言给出、而非附有可机器检验的 Lean 证书的成果。

openai/math 仓库共收录 722 篇手稿、分属 372 个成果系列，以 Apache-2.0 许可发布。其中部分证明包含可供计算机检验的 Lean 形式化内容，另一部分则没有。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI withdrew three math papers from its public repository, spotlighting questions about the reliability and formal verification of AI-generated mathematical proofs.

ranking.title_zh: OpenAI发布GPT-6系列模型并推进产品更新
ranking.title_en: OpenAI releases GPT-6 family models and rolls out product updates
ranking.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 28 天产品冲刺第 4 天将 GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast 推向 API、Codex 和 ChatGPT Work，Codex 生成速度最高达标准模式 8 倍，API 定价为标准档 6 倍；Codex 还新增任务执行中途实时纠偏能力。
ranking.summary_en: On Day 4 of OpenAI's 28-day product sprint, OpenAI rolled out GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast to API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work, with up to 8x faster generation in Codex and API pricing at 6x standard; Codex also gained real-time mid-task redirect capability.
ranking.latest_update_zh: OpenAI 在 28 天产品冲刺第 4 天推出 GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast，向 API、Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 推送，Codex 中生成速度最高达标准模式的 8 倍，API 价格为标准档的 6 倍；同时改进 Codex 中途纠偏功能，允许用户在 Agent 执行任务时补充要求或纠正方向。
ranking.latest_update_en: On Day 4 of OpenAI's 28-day product sprint, OpenAI rolled out GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast to API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work, with up to 8x faster generation in Codex and API pricing at 6x standard; it also improved Codex mid-task redirect, letting users add requests or correct direction while the agent is executing.
ranking.background_zh: GPT-6是OpenAI在GPT-5系列之后推出的新一代主力模型。“智能界面”这一思路延续了生成式界面（generative UI）的概念，即由模型根据提示或上下文生成界面元素，而不仅仅是文字。
ranking.background_en: GPT-6 is OpenAI's next major model in the GPT series, following the GPT-5 family. The 'Intelligent UI' concept extends the idea of generative UI, in which a model generates interface elements — not just text — in response to a prompt or context.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: OpenAI rolled out GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast to its API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work with up to 8x faster generation in Codex at 6x standard token pricing, alongside a new Codex feature letting users redirect agent tasks mid-execution.
ranking.latest_summary_en: OpenAI rolled out GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast to its API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work with up to 8x faster generation in Codex at 6x standard token pricing, alongside a new Codex feature letting users redirect agent tasks mid-execution.
ranking.market_impact_zh: ChatGPT是消费级AI的重要分发渠道，因此其平台层面转向可交互、可渲染的回答形式，主要通过情绪面对加密市场中的AI叙事板块产生关联，而非源于任何已公布的加密集成。现有材料中未提及直接的托管、流动性或链上关联。
ranking.market_impact_en: ChatGPT is a major distribution channel for consumer AI, so a platform-wide shift toward interactive, rendered answers touches the AI-narrative segment of crypto markets mainly through sentiment rather than any announced crypto integration. No direct custody, liquidity or on-chain linkage is described in the available material.

timeline.text_en: On Day 4 of OpenAI's 28-day product sprint, OpenAI rolled out GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast to API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work, with up to 8x faster generation in Codex and API pricing at 6x standard; it also improved Codex mid-task redirect, letting users add requests or correct direction while the agent is executing.

timeline.text_zh: OpenAI全球发布GPT-6和Intelligent UI，面向所有ChatGPT用户，让模型融合文本、视觉内容和交互元素，并生成游戏、交互式预算计算器等对话内工具。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI globally launched GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for all ChatGPT users, letting the model blend text, visual content, and interactive elements and generate in-conversation tools such as games and interactive budget calculators.

timeline.text_zh: 在OpenAI为期28天的产品冲刺第3天，GPT-6率先在ChatGPT聊天界面中面向Plus、Pro、Business和Enterprise用户推出（Free和Go用户随后跟进），同时还有消息称Codex与ChatGPT Work合计活跃用户达到4000万，且所有付费账户将获得一次性存储用量重置，有效期为一个月。
timeline.text_en: On Day 3 of OpenAI's 28-day product sprint, GPT-6 launched inside the ChatGPT chat interface first for Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users (Free and Go to follow), alongside news that Codex and ChatGPT Work together hit 40 million active users and that all paid accounts will receive a one-time banked usage reset valid for a month.

ranking.title_zh: Blast 宣布停止 Layer 2 运营并要求用户提取资产
ranking.title_en: Bithumb将BLAST列入交易注意名单，因Blast宣布主网运营结束计划
ranking.summary_zh: Blast 因维护成本超过收入而停止运营，用户需在 10 月 26 日前通过常规界面将资产撤回以太坊主网；提现等待时间计划缩短至 24 小时，但团队先退出其 Lido 资产，预计约一周内提现功能暂时不可用，截止后仍可通过以太坊 L1 上的 Blast Bridge 合约提取。Bithumb 与 Upbit 已将 BLAST 列入交易注意名单并暂停充值；Coinbase 发布状态更新，要求用户在 10 月 26 日前将 BLAST 转出，媒体报道其将于 10 月 20 日暂停 BLAST 交易。
ranking.summary_en: Blast is ceasing operations because maintenance costs exceed revenue; users need to withdraw assets to Ethereum mainnet via the standard interface by Oct. 26; withdrawal wait time is planned to be shortened to 24 hours, but withdrawals are temporarily unavailable for about a week while Blast exits its Lido holdings, and after the deadline assets can still be withdrawn via the Blast Bridge contract on Ethereum L1. Bithumb and Upbit added BLAST to trading-caution watchlists and suspended deposits; Coinbase posted a status update requiring users to move BLAST off Coinbase by Oct. 26, with media reports that it will suspend BLAST trading on Oct. 20.
ranking.latest_update_zh: Coinbase 于 10 月 7 日发布状态更新，确认 Blast 网络正在被项目团队关停，并要求用户必须在 2026 年 10 月 26 日前将 BLAST 转出 Coinbase，否则网络关停后将无法访问这些资产；媒体报道称 Coinbase 将于 10 月 20 日暂停 BLAST 交易。
ranking.latest_update_en: Coinbase posted a status update on Oct 7 confirming the Blast network is being shut down by the project team and requiring users to move BLAST off Coinbase before Oct 26, 2026, or lose access after shutdown; media reports say Coinbase will suspend BLAST trading on Oct 20.
ranking.background_zh: Blast 是一条以太坊二层网络，在 2024 年 2 月主网上线时吸引了 23 亿美元存款，最初主打 ETH 与稳定币持仓的原生收益。有报道称，团队于 2026 年 10 月 2 日宣布逐步关停，理由是运营成本已超过二层网络收入，且看不到可信的经济可持续路径。
ranking.background_en: Blast is an Ethereum layer-2 network that drew $2.3 billion in deposits by its February 2024 mainnet launch and initially pitched native yield on ETH and stablecoin holdings. Reports say the team announced the wind-down on October 2, 2026, citing operating costs that exceed L2 revenue with no credible path to economic sustainability.
ranking.latest_summary_zh:
Coinbase 于 10 月 7 日 15:50（太平洋时间）发布状态更新，称 Blast 项目团队正在关停 Blast 网络，用户必须采取操作以避免失去资金访问权限。Coinbase 表示，若未在 2026 年 10 月 26 日之前将 BLAST 转出该交易所，网络关停后将无法再访问这些资产。

该通知把网络关停变成了对仍将 BLAST 存放在 Coinbase 的用户的硬性截止期限：2026 年 10 月 26 日之后，未转出的资产将无法访问。

Coinbase 将该条目标注为计划内维护，并表示将按需提供更新。有关此次关停的媒体报道称，Coinbase 将于 10 月 20 日暂停 BLAST 交易，早于 10 月 26 日的提现截止日期。
ranking.latest_summary_en:
Coinbase posted a status update on October 7 (15:50 PDT) stating that the Blast project team is shutting down the Blast network and that users must act to avoid losing access to their funds. Coinbase said BLAST that is not moved off the exchange before October 26, 2026 will not be accessible to users after the network is shut down.

The notice turns the shutdown into a hard deadline for anyone still holding BLAST on Coinbase: assets left in place become inaccessible after October 26, 2026.

Coinbase labeled the entry as scheduled maintenance and said it would provide updates as necessary. Media reports on the shutdown state that Coinbase suspends BLAST trading on October 20, ahead of the October 26 withdrawal deadline.
ranking.market_impact_zh: 传导路径经由交易所托管与提现基础设施：存放在 Coinbase 的 BLAST 必须在截止日期前转出，随着网络关停，资金流将集中到该代币剩余的交易场所与提现通道。这也会影响市场对以太坊二层网络经济模型的情绪，不过此次关停属于有序退出，而非故障或漏洞事件。
ranking.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through exchange custody and withdrawal infrastructure: BLAST held on Coinbase must be moved before the deadline, which concentrates flow into the token's remaining trading venues and withdrawal rails as the network winds down. It also feeds sentiment about the economics of Ethereum layer-2 networks, though the shutdown is an orderly sunset rather than a failure or exploit.

ranking.title_zh: Solana 主网完成 350ms、300ms、250ms 出块时间削减，并计划激活 200ms 目标
ranking.title_en: Solana Activates 350ms Slots on Mainnet, First Cut Since Genesis
ranking.summary_zh: SIMD-0525 的 200 毫秒目标已激活并宣布完成，Anza 确认升级落地；社区注意力转向 Alpenglow 共识改造（目标约 150 毫秒最终性），其已在测试网和开发网部署，但主网激活日期尚未公布。
ranking.summary_en: The 200-millisecond target of SIMD-0525 has been activated and declared complete by Anza; attention now shifts to the Alpenglow consensus overhaul targeting ~150ms finality, which has been deployed on testnet and devnet but has no announced mainnet activation date.
ranking.latest_update_zh: Solana 已于 10 月 9 日在主网激活 200 毫秒出块时间，完成 SIMD-0525 从 400 毫秒起的四阶段缩减，区块生产机会提升至每秒 5 个，epoch 时长由约 48 小时缩短至约 24 小时；同时交易 blockhash 有效期从约 60 秒缩短至约 30 秒。
ranking.latest_update_en: Solana activated 200-millisecond slots on mainnet on Oct. 9, completing the four-stage SIMD-0525 reduction from 400ms: block-production opportunities rose to five per second, epoch duration fell from about 48 hours to about 24 hours, and transaction blockhash expiry shrank from about 60 seconds to about 30 seconds.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Solana activated 200-millisecond slots on mainnet, cutting its original 400ms block-production target in half, increasing block opportunities to five per second and shortening epochs to roughly 24 hours ahead of the still-unscheduled Alpenglow upgrade targeting 150ms finality.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Solana activated 200-millisecond slots on mainnet, cutting its original 400ms block-production target in half, increasing block opportunities to five per second and shortening epochs to roughly 24 hours ahead of the still-unscheduled Alpenglow upgrade targeting 150ms finality.

timeline.text_zh: Solana 已于 10 月 9 日在主网激活 200 毫秒出块时间，完成 SIMD-0525 从 400 毫秒起的四阶段缩减，区块生产机会提升至每秒 5 个，epoch 时长由约 48 小时缩短至约 24 小时；同时交易 blockhash 有效期从约 60 秒缩短至约 30 秒。
timeline.text_en: Solana activated 200-millisecond slots on mainnet on Oct. 9, completing the four-stage SIMD-0525 reduction from 400ms: block-production opportunities rose to five per second, epoch duration fell from about 48 hours to about 24 hours, and transaction blockhash expiry shrank from about 60 seconds to about 30 seconds.

timeline.text_zh: Solana已在350毫秒后进一步将出块时间降至300毫秒和250毫秒，并计划在epoch 1053将目标出块时间最终降至200毫秒，完成SIMD-0525从400毫秒开始的缩减序列。
timeline.text_en: Solana has progressed beyond the 350ms cut to 300ms and 250ms, and is scheduled to make a final reduction to 200ms target block time at epoch 1053, completing the SIMD-0525 sequence of cuts from 400ms.

timeline.text_zh: Solana 正在安排最后一次削减至 200 毫秒出块时间，通过降低单区块计算上限来补偿，而验证者将面临更频繁的投票和更短的出块窗口。
timeline.text_en: Solana is scheduling its final cut to 200-millisecond slots, compensating with smaller per-block compute limits while validators face more frequent voting and shorter block-production windows.
